Location : Zurich, Geneva Switzerland Work Pattern Percentage : 80-100% Help transform our clients’ organisations to support their business strategy Deloitte's Human Capital Consulting practice in Switzerland is at the forefront of transforming how organizations attract, develop, and retain their most valuable asset—their people. We partner with leading Swiss and international companies to reimagine their HR operating models, implement cutting-edge HR technology solutions, and build future-ready organizations. Our team combines deep HR expertise with advanced technology knowledge to deliver transformational outcomes across strategy, technology, and organizational change. We work across diverse industries and geographies, helping clients navigate the evolving world of work, embrace digital innovation, and unlock the full potential of their workforce. We are the largest Human Capital practice in the Swiss market and are widely recognized by our clients for our ability to walk in their shoes as a true partner, bring leading insight, expertise and consistently deliver high quality work. How you can make an impact
• As a Senior Consultant / Manager in our HR Strategy & Technology practice, you will be a trusted strategic advisor helping organizations optimize their HR operating models, payroll operations, and HR service delivery. You will:
• Lead HR Strategy Engagements - Partner with C-suite and HR leadership to develop comprehensive HR strategies, HR process and policies designs, and operating models that drive business value
• Advise on Payroll Transformation - Provide expert guidance on payroll optimization, outsourcing decisions, technology implementations, and process improvements across complex, multi-country environments
• Optimize HR Service Delivery - Help clients evaluate and redesign their HR service delivery models, including shared services, business process outsourcing, and technology enablement
• Manage Strategic Client Relationships - Build and maintain strategic partnerships with key stakeholders, serving as the primary advisor for complex, high-value engagements
• Develop Integrated Solutions - Create holistic HR solutions that combine strategy, process redesign, technology, and organizational change to deliver measurable business outcomes
• Mentor and Develop Talent - Guide junior consultants and team members, sharing your expertise and fostering their growth in HR advisory and consulting
• Contribute to Thought Leadership - Develop insights on HR trends, payroll innovation, and organizational effectiveness; publish thought leadership content and represent Deloitte at industry events
• Shape Our Practice - Contribute to the growth and evolution of our HR Strategy & Technology practice in Switzerland, helping us stay at the forefront of HR transformation Who are we looking for?
• Strong academic background, ideally a Master’s degree or MBA from a reputable institution, or equivalent professional experience
• Minimum 4 years of professional experience in HR advisory, HR consulting, or HR operations, with a focus on Payroll and HR Services is a must
• Demonstrated expertise in Payroll strategy, Payroll outsourcing, Payroll technology, and Payroll operations optimization
• Strong experience with HR service delivery models, shared services, and business process outsourcing
• Proven track record of leading / supporting successful HR transformation and advisory projects
• Deep understanding of HR processes, payroll regulations, and organizational structures
• Experience working with multinational organizations and complex, multi-country HR and payroll environments
• Fluency in written and spoken English and German is essential; proficiency in additional languages such as French is an advantage
• Excellent people management skills and an enthusiastic, positive, 'can do' attitude
• An incisive thinker, confident with concepts, analysis and frameworks, with the ability to structure work and deliver under pressure
• An excellent relationship builder with clients and fellow consultants, with great interpersonal skills and the ability to build and sustain long-term relationships
• Willingness to travel within Switzerland and internationally as required. Your team Become part of a diverse, multinational and highly motivated team. We will help you grow both personally and professionally: through our trainings, mentoring programmes and on-the-job learning, but also by connecting with your colleagues across all business lines. Life at Deloitte At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact. In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors. We offer meaningful and challenging work, an inclusive and supportive environment where you can be your best self and where you will never stop growing. You will benefit from flexible and hybrid working conditions, wellbeing and parental programmes as well as many opportunities to connect, collaborate and learn. Join us and become part of a global network of like-minded people dedicated to making a difference, whether by addressing climate change or improving 100 million futures by 2030. Want to know more about opportunities at Deloitte? Visit www.deloitte.com/ch/careers . How to apply We look forward to hearing from you! Please click on "apply now" to submit a complete application, including CV, cover letter, references and degree certificates. If you have any questions, please contact Pieter-Jan at talent@deloitte.ch . *We consider all qualified applicants for employment regardless of race, ethnicity, religious beliefs, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability, in accordance with applicable law. Research shows that women are less likely to apply for roles unless they match all the criteria; don’t hold yourself back - apply today. jobs.description:
Location: Geneva Work Pattern Percentage : 80-100% Help our clients solve the biggest challenges of their IT organisation As a (Senior) Consultant at Deloitte, you will join our Technology Strategy & Transformation specialists and help organizations to develop strategies and implement systems that build business value and drive performance. We combine in-depth knowledge and experience gained from working on some of the most complex IT projects around the globe, from system replacement to full IT transformation. By enriching us as our newest member, you will gain valuable insights into IT strategy and operating model design, IT architecture, IT business management, IT agility advisory, and IT M&A - we’re looking forward to having you with us! How you can make an impact
• Collaborate with our client’s key technology executives to translate their strategies into effective IT operating models
• Support clients from major Swiss and international organisations to strengthen their IT function and technology capabilities while embracing agile practices
• Make an impact on large-scale IT transformation programmes and shape how the IT function interacts with the business side
• Assess the IT service requirements of our clients, derive tailor-made technology target operating models, and enable business access to IT services Who re we looking for?
• You display strong analytical skills and are able to communicate and present ideas and findings both orally and in writing
• You are well versed in the use of MS Office, demonstrate project management skills, and were able to gain previous experience in IT process management, business partnering, or organisational development
• After graduating in (business) informatics, business administration, or economics, you were able to build up a track record of managing small engagements or parts of larger ones; any ITIL or Agile certifications are a huge plus
• Throughout your career, you have gained professional experience (3 years +) working with technology operating models and bringing about IT transformation in a consulting or corporate environment
• You communicate fluently in English and French or German and look forward to travelling (mainly within Switzerland); additional French skills are an advantage Your team By joining the team in our Zurich office, you will be integrated into a diverse group of like-minded colleagues right from the start. As part of the Technology Strategy & Transformation team, you will work directly with our clients to optimize Technology Organisations and shape the way IT interacts with the business. Our commitment to your professional development translates into an extensive internal and external training programme. Joining us also means benefiting from our in-depth understanding of technology, excellent communication skills and broad business understanding. At Deloitte Switzerland, within our Controllership & Treasury team in Technology & Transformation, you will play a pivotal role in helping organisations manage and transform their technology risk frameworks. Your work will help organisations strengthen their internal controls, ensuring compliance and operational excellence in a dynamic environment. Day-to-day, you will contribute to technology risk & controls transformation projects and provide expert guidance on technology risk improvements. What You’ll Do
• Lead strategic initiatives to support clients in assessing technology risks, defining control scopes, and designing or enhancing IT controls and compliance frameworks
• Lead internal controls transformation initiatives (e.g. automation), delivering pragmatic and innovative solutions to complex technology risk challenges.
• Identify emerging technology risk issues and convert them into actionable business opportunities.
• Collaborate across multidisciplinary teams to support go-to-market strategies and develop cutting-edge technology risk advisory offerings.
• Contribute to the creation of innovative tools and assets that drive the future of technology risk and controls transformation. Who we are looking for
• A proactive, adaptable, keen to grow and have strong interpersonal and communication skills and focused on building good relationships with clients
• Minimum of 4 - 6 years of experience in IT controls advisory, audit, or risk management, including risk assessment, control design, testing, and remediation.
• Proven expertise in internal controls design, implementation, and continuous improvement.
• Solid knowledge of IT risk and governance frameworks such as COBIT, ISO 27001, and NIST. Knowledge of artificial intelligence (AI) and machine learning (ML), with the ability to leverage AI-driven insights in control environments.
• Holder of relevant certifications such as CRISC, CISA, CISM, COBIT , CGEIT, or equivalent.
• Fluent in English and German, with the ability to engage effectively with diverse stakeholders. Your Team & Career Growth Our Controllership & Treasury team, part of Technology & Transformation, has been one of the fastest-growing teams in Switzerland over the last years. Thus, we can offer unrivalled career growth & learning opportunities as well as an exciting place to work. Successful candidates will get the opportunity to help us shape the future of compliance, develop further our market offering and work closely with the world-top organizations on their controls transformation journey. Careers at Deloitte. Choose your impact. At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. jobs.description:
Location: Geneva/Zurich Work Pattern Percentage: 80% - 100% Help our clients to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of their companies By joining our Valuation and Modeling team, you will learn how to support finance and corporate leaders make complex strategic investment decisions, analyse enterprise performance, develop financial business plans, and quantify the success of M&A deals and value creation initiatives. We bring in-depth corporate finance knowledge and experience, coupled with valuation expertise and financial modeling capabilities, to our clients’ most complex transactions, transformations, and corporate events around the globe. How you can make an impact
• Be part of of a team of highly specialised Valuation & Modelling practitioners, combining core capabilities across finance, capital markets, corporate development & investment, financial planning, M&A, and strategy.
• Lead diverse projects across a range of industries, from valuing businesses and assets, to building financial models that capture a company’s economic essence, to working with Boards and the C-Suite on quantifying and creating shareholder value.
• Assess our clients’ financial and business challenges, evaluate suitable solutions based on quantitative analysis, market research, data modeling, and strategic business planning.
• Provide support in the valuation of businesses and intangible assets (e.g. brands, customer relationships, IP portfolios, etc.) for mergers and acquisitions, litigation support, dispute resolution, financial reporting, purchase price allocations, restructuring, and financial advisory.
• Perform research and analysis on various sectors and industries and prepare financial and economic analyses on companies, comparable transactions and public companies using Deloitte databases and other publicly available information.
• Develop detailed financial models in Excel using best practice financial modelling techniques, in the context of transactions, financing, capital investment decisions, and strategic corporate planning. Use these models to analyze and forecast financial outcomes and assist in decision-making processes.
• Present findings and analysis in compelling presentations and reports to effectively communicate insights and recommendations. Who We Are Looking For
• You are a curious and committed team player with the ability to learn and apply new information quickly, who likes to work methodically with great attention to detail, willing to take on responsibility and adopt a proactive attitude in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment and to thrive under pressure.
• You have 3-5 years of post-university experience applying the core tenets of valuation and corporate finance in the context of transactions or corporate planning, as well as a high proficiency in building advanced financial models, within another consulting firm, private equity, M&A, FP&A or corporate development practice.
• You are a CFA charterholder or in the process of completing CFA.
• You bring demonstrable capabilities in corporate finance with a track record of building complex financial models, together with a fluency in valuation and accounting principles and standards.
• You are equipped with advanced skills in Excel and Powerpoint.
• Fluent in English and German (oral and writing skills), French would be an advantage. Your Team We are a highly strategic, advisory-driven Valuation & Modelling practice, experiencing strong growth within the Swiss market. Our team is diverse, multinational, and entrepreneurial, split between Zurich and Geneva. A career within our Valuation & Modelling team will equip you with market-leading skills and experiences, and support your development with comprehensive mentoring and internal and external training programmes. Careers at Deloitte. Choose your impact. At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact. With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors. We offer meaningful and challenging work, an inclusive and supportive environment where you can be your best self and where you will never stop growing. You will benefit from flexible and hybrid working conditions, wellbeing and parental programmes as well as many opportunities to connect, collaborate and learn. Join us and become part of a global network of like-minded people dedicated to making a difference, whether by addressing climate change or improving 100 million futures by 2030. Location : Zurich Work Pattern Percentage : 80-100% Join Deloitte Switzerland’s Third-Party Advisory & Technology Implementation team and empower organisations through technology‑enabled transformation journeys In a world that is constantly driven by emerging risks and technological advances, organisations need to adapt quickly to remain competitive in the market. The Third Party Advisory and Implementation team assists in identifying, evaluating and mitigating risks associated with external business relationships through advisory, implementation and operate services. We focus on enhancing the maturity of our client’s third party Management (TPM) processes, covering both third party risk management (TPRM) and contract lifecycle management (CLM) activities. This includes setting up Third Party Management frameworks to deploying technologies to manage third party relationships. The Third Party Advisory team drives the growth of TPRM and CLM technology implementations across industries by building strong relationships with leading vendors and combining deep product knowledge with market leading TPRM and CLM strategy and design expertise. How you can make an impact We have a new and exciting opportunity for someone to join our Zurich-based team as a Technology Solution Senior Consultant, to help support the growth of our implementation capability and deliver complex large-scale technology transformation journeys. The role would involve working directly with senior leaders within the team to deliver the implementation of cloud-based SaaS TPRM and/or CLM solutions to clients, including the integration of these solutions with existing client platforms. In addition, the role will provide a great opportunity to develop leading methodologies for delivery of these implementation projects and to support eminence activity with key TPRM and CLM technology vendors. What you’ll do: As a Third Party Advisory and Technology Solution Senior Consultant with experience of large-scale technology implementations, you will have responsibility for:
• Analysing a client’s TPRM and/or CLM processes, and providing advisory services to enhance their existing ways of working
• Supporting clients in technology capability assessments, and identifying configuration and integration opportunities for the client’s selected TPRM and/or CLM technology
• Translating business requirements into technology capabilities, and developing an end-to-end implementation plan based on the TPRM and/or CLM technology selected, including configuration plans, UAT scripts, and integration strategies
• Supporting the business and technical teams during design, build, test and deployment phases of a TPRM and/or CLM Technology Implementation
• Configuring and build integration solutions that meet the client’s business requirements
• Leading delivery of detailed integration architecture including software and infrastructure components - considering functionality, data, security, integration, infrastructure and performance
• Creating and maintaining technical documentation where required for the implementation Who we are looking for:
• Technical solution experience, ideally on large scale, complex cloud-based SaaS implementations
• Specific experience with configuring and implementing market leading TPRM or Contract Management Technologies (e.g. OneTrust, ProcessUnity, ServiceNow, Icertis, Sirion, DocuSign)
• In-depth understanding of the different integration vendors and technologies, and key differences between these
• Experience of acting within a Solution Architect role and proven expertise in an IT development background.
• Knowledge of artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities, with the ability to leverage AI-driven insights within daily tasks
• Knowledge or experience working in the area of Risk Consulting and/or professional services will be considered an advantage
• Fluency in English is mandatory; German would be considered an advantage What you bring to succeed in the role
• Highly organised individual with strong attention to detail and able to manage their own workload
• Strong communication skills, written and verbal, both internally and externally with clients and third parties, and be able to communicate clearly and effectively to all levels
• Ability to build professional relationships and rapport within the team and its clients
• Proactive, self-starter & committed individual seeking to add value in the role
• Strong ability to plan around and manage changing environments and priorities throughout a cloud based Saas implementation project for global organizations across multiple workstreams Your Team & Career Growth : Our team, part of Technology & Transformation, has been one of the fastest-growing teams in Switzerland over the last years. Thus, we can offer unrivalled career growth & learning opportunities as well as an exciting place to work. descriptionByLocale.it:
Percentuale: 80-100% Unisciti al team di consulenza e implementazione della tecnologia di Deloitte Switzerland e potenzia le organizzazioni attraverso percorsi di trasformazione tecnologicamente avanzati In un mondo costantemente guidato da rischi emergenti e progressi tecnologici, le organizzazioni devono adattarsi rapidamente per rimanere competitivi sul mercato. Il team di Consulenza e Attuazione di Terze Parti assiste nell'individuazione, nella valutazione e nella mitigazione dei rischi associati alle relazioni aziendali esterne attraverso servizi di consulenza, implementazione e gestione. Ci concentriamo sul miglioramento della maturità dei processi di gestione dei terzi del nostro cliente (TPM), coprendo sia le attività di gestione del rischio di terze parti (TPRM) che di gestione del ciclo di vita contrattuale (CLM). Ciò include la creazione di quadri di gestione di terze parti per distribuire le tecnologie per gestire le relazioni di terze parti. Il team Advisory di Terze Parti guida la crescita delle implementazioni tecnologiche TPRM e CLM in tutte le industrie costruendo forti relazioni con i principali fornitori e combinando la profonda conoscenza dei prodotti con le principali competenze di strategia e progettazione TPRM e CLM. Abbiamo una nuova ed entusiasmante opportunità per unire il nostro team di Zurigo come consulente senior della soluzione tecnologica, per aiutare a sostenere la crescita della nostra capacità di implementazione e fornire complessi viaggi di trasformazione tecnologica su larga scala. Il ruolo consisterebbe nel lavorare direttamente con i leader senior all'interno del team per fornire l'implementazione di soluzioni cloud-based SaaS TPRM e/o CLM ai clienti, inclusa l'integrazione di queste soluzioni con piattaforme client esistenti. Inoltre, il ruolo fornirà una grande opportunità per sviluppare metodologie leader per la consegna di questi progetti di implementazione e per sostenere l'attività di eminenza con i principali fornitori di tecnologia TPRM e CLM. Cosa farete: In qualità di consulente di terze parti e consulente di soluzioni tecnologiche senior con esperienza di grandi implementazioni tecnologiche, avrete la responsabilità di:
• Analizzare i processi TPRM e/o CLM di un cliente e fornire servizi di consulenza per migliorare i loro modi di lavoro esistenti
• Sostenere i clienti nelle valutazioni delle capacità tecnologiche e individuare opportunità di configurazione e integrazione per la tecnologia TPRM e/o CLM selezionata dal cliente
• Tradurre i requisiti aziendali nelle capacità tecnologiche e sviluppare un piano di implementazione end-to-end basato sulla tecnologia TPRM e/o CLM selezionata, compresi i piani di configurazione, gli script UAT e le strategie di integrazione
• Sostenere i team aziendali e tecnici durante le fasi di progettazione, costruzione, test e distribuzione di un TPRM e/o CLM Technology Implementation
• Configurare e costruire soluzioni di integrazione che soddisfano i requisiti aziendali del cliente
• Fornitura leader di architettura di integrazione dettagliata tra componenti software e infrastruttura - considerando funzionalità, dati, sicurezza, integrazione, infrastruttura e prestazioni

Location : Zurich Work Pattern Percentage : 80-100% Join Deloitte Switzerland’s Third-Party Advisory & Technology Implementation team and empower organisations through technology‑enabled transformation journeys In a world that is constantly driven by emerging risks and technological advances, organisations need to adapt quickly to remain competitive in the market. The Third Party Advisory and Implementation team assists in identifying, evaluating and mitigating risks associated with external business relationships through advisory, implementation and operate services. We focus on enhancing the maturity of our client’s third party Management (TPM) processes, covering both third party risk management (TPRM) and contract lifecycle management (CLM) activities. This includes setting up Third Party Management frameworks to deploying technologies to manage third party relationships. The Third Party Advisory team drives the growth of TPRM and CLM technology implementations across industries by building strong relationships with leading vendors and combining deep product knowledge with market leading TPRM and CLM strategy and design expertise. How you can make an impact We have a new and exciting opportunity for someone to join our Zurich-based team as a Technology Solution Senior Consultant, to help support the growth of our implementation capability and deliver complex large-scale technology transformation journeys. The role would involve working directly with senior leaders within the team to deliver the implementation of cloud-based SaaS TPRM and/or CLM solutions to clients, including the integration of these solutions with existing client platforms. In addition, the role will provide a great opportunity to develop leading methodologies for delivery of these implementation projects and to support eminence activity with key TPRM and CLM technology vendors. What you’ll do: As a Third Party Advisory and Technology Solution Senior Consultant with experience of large-scale technology implementations, you will have responsibility for:
• Analysing a client’s TPRM and/or CLM processes, and providing advisory services to enhance their existing ways of working
• Supporting clients in technology capability assessments, and identifying configuration and integration opportunities for the client’s selected TPRM and/or CLM technology
• Translating business requirements into technology capabilities, and developing an end-to-end implementation plan based on the TPRM and/or CLM technology selected, including configuration plans, UAT scripts, and integration strategies
• Supporting the business and technical teams during design, build, test and deployment phases of a TPRM and/or CLM Technology Implementation
• Configuring and build integration solutions that meet the client’s business requirements
• Leading delivery of detailed integration architecture including software and infrastructure components - considering functionality, data, security, integration, infrastructure and performance
• Creating and maintaining technical documentation where required for the implementation Who we are looking for:
• Technical solution experience, ideally on large scale, complex cloud-based SaaS implementations
• Specific experience with configuring and implementing market leading TPRM or Contract Management Technologies (e.g. OneTrust, ProcessUnity, ServiceNow, Icertis, Sirion, DocuSign)
• In-depth understanding of the different integration vendors and technologies, and key differences between these
• Experience of acting within a Solution Architect role and proven expertise in an IT development background.
• Knowledge of artificial intelligence (AI) capabilities, with the ability to leverage AI-driven insights within daily tasks
• Knowledge or experience working in the area of Risk Consulting and/or professional services will be considered an advantage
• Fluency in English is mandatory; German would be considered an advantage What you bring to succeed in the role
• Highly organised individual with strong attention to detail and able to manage their own workload
• Strong communication skills, written and verbal, both internally and externally with clients and third parties, and be able to communicate clearly and effectively to all levels
• Ability to build professional relationships and rapport within the team and its clients
• Proactive, self-starter & committed individual seeking to add value in the role
• Strong ability to plan around and manage changing environments and priorities throughout a cloud based Saas implementation project for global organizations across multiple workstreams Your Team & Career Growth : Our team, part of Technology & Transformation, has been one of the fastest-growing teams in Switzerland over the last years. Thus, we can offer unrivalled career growth & learning opportunities as well as an exciting place to work. Successful candidates will get the opportunity to help us shape the future of compliance, develop further our market offering and work closely with the world-top organizations on their third party management transformation journey. Life at Deloitte​ At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact. In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors. We offer meaningful and challenging work, an inclusive and supportive environment where you can be your best self and where you will never stop growing. You will benefit from flexible and hybrid working conditions, wellbeing and parental programmes as well as many opportunities to connect, collaborate and learn. Join us and become part of a global network of like-minded people dedicated to making a difference, whether by addressing climate change or improving 100 million futures by 2030. Wir konzentrieren uns auf die Verbesserung der Reife der Third Party Management (TPM)-Prozesse unserer Kunden, die sowohl die Aktivitäten des Third Party Risk Management (TPRM) als auch des Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) umfassen. Lieu : Zurich Profil de travail Pourcentage : 80-100% Rejoignez Deloitte Suisse Assemblez l'équipe de conseil et de mise en œuvre technologique de tiers et autonomisez les organisations grâce à des parcours de transformation technologique Dans un monde constamment animé par les risques émergents et les avancées technologiques, les organisations doivent s'adapter rapidement pour rester compétitives sur le marché. L'équipe de conseil et de mise en oeuvre de tiers aide à cerner, évaluer et atténuer les risques associés aux relations d'affaires externes par le biais de services de conseil, de mise en oeuvre et d'exploitation. Nous nous concentrons sur l'amélioration de la maturité de nos processus de gestion par des tiers (GPT), couvrant à la fois les activités de gestion des risques par des tiers (GPT) et de gestion du cycle de vie des contrats (GPT). Cela comprend la mise en place de cadres de gestion de tiers pour déployer des technologies pour gérer les relations de tiers. L'équipe consultative de tiers est à l'origine de la croissance de la mise en oeuvre des technologies TPRM et CLM dans l'ensemble des industries en établissant des relations solides avec les principaux fournisseurs et en combinant des connaissances approfondies sur les produits avec la stratégie TPRM et CLM de pointe du marché et l'expertise en conception. Comment vous pouvez avoir un impact Nous avons une nouvelle et passionnante occasion pour quelqu'un de rejoindre notre équipe basée à Zurich en tant que consultant senior Technology Solution, pour aider à soutenir le développement de notre capacité de mise en œuvre et de livrer des voyages complexes de transformation technologique à grande échelle. Ce rôle consisterait à travailler directement avec les hauts responsables de l'équipe afin de fournir aux clients la mise en œuvre de solutions de gestion de l'information sur le cloud SaaS TPRM et/ou CLM, y compris l'intégration de ces solutions aux plateformes client existantes. En outre, ce rôle offrira une excellente occasion d'élaborer des méthodes de pointe pour l'exécution de ces projets de mise en œuvre et d'appuyer les activités d'éminence auprès des principaux fournisseurs de technologies TPRM et CLM. • Soutenir les clients dans les évaluations des capacités technologiques et identifier les possibilités de configuration et d'intégration pour les clients sélectionnés TPRM et/ou la technologie CLM
• Traduire les exigences opérationnelles en capacités technologiques et élaborer un plan de mise en œuvre de bout en bout basé sur la technologie TPRM et/ou CLM sélectionnée, y compris les plans de configuration, les scripts UAT et les stratégies d'intégration
• Soutenir les équipes professionnelles et techniques pendant la conception, la construction, l'essai et le déploiement d'un PTRM et/ou de la mise en œuvre de la technologie CLM
• Configurer et construire des solutions d'intégration qui répondent aux exigences du client
• Diriger la prestation de l'architecture d'intégration détaillée, y compris les composants logiciels et infrastructure - en tenant compte de la fonctionnalité, des données, de la sécurité, de l'intégration, de l'infrastructure et des performances

• Expérience de solution technique, idéalement sur des implémentations SaaS complexes basées sur le cloud à grande échelle

• Les connaissances ou l'expérience dans le domaine de la consultation sur les risques et/ou des services professionnels seront considérées comme un avantage

Location: Zurich Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100% Finding the talent­ that makes Deloitte unique Drive the Progress of Controls Transformation Working with the Controls Transformation team means you will help our clients achieve their business performance goals by using different techniques and the latest technology to build up smart, lean and efficient internal control frameworks that meet the needs of the business as well as the digital world of the future. Your day-to-day tasks may include delivering projects related to controls transformation on an operational and strategic level and advising clients on how to leverage the ERP functionalities, mainly SAP S/4HANA, to optimize the design of internal controls. How you can make an impact · Advising clients on controls enhancement opportunities aiming to embrace technology such as ERP functionalities (SAP S/4HANA) · Supporting clients in transforming their internal controls framework whilst staying compliant · Leading projects, covering all aspects of engagement delivery; from scoping, programme and team selection, through to delivery, risk & quality management · Supporting SAP Internal Controls go-to-market initiatives and collaborating across multi-disciplinary teams to develop new market offerings and advance existing ones · Leading, inspiring, developing and coaching the team Who we are looking for · You are organized, have strong interpersonal skills, and excellent communication skills which allow you to build good relationships with clients, and to manage and develop others in an advisory role · You have a minimum of 2-4 years of experience in delivering ERP controls transformation or ERP audit projects, and have a good understanding of the main SAP S/4HANA business processes and how to leverage the new functionalities for compliance and internal controls purposes · You are familiar with automated controls in the shape of ERP configurations · You have good knowledge of the core business processes (e.g. PTP, OTC, RTR, Treasury, Tax, HR, etc.) and related key risk management concepts · You have in-depth experience in internal controls design, remediation, and implementation · You are completely fluent in English. German would be highly advantageous. Your team Our Controls Transformation team is one of the fastest growing across Deloitte Switzerland. Thus, we can offer unrivalled career growth & learning opportunities as well as an exciting place to work. Successful candidates will get the opportunity to help us shape the future of compliance, develop further our market offering and work closely with the world-top organizations on their controls transformation journey. Careers at Deloitte. Choose your impact. At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact. In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors. 
• We offer meaningful and challenging work, an inclusive and supportive environment where you can be your best self and where you will never stop growing. You will benefit from flexible and hybrid working conditions, wellbeing and parental programmes as well as many opportunities to connect, collaborate and learn. Join us and become part of a global network of like-minded people dedicated to making a difference, whether by addressing climate change or improving 100 million futures by 2030. Want to know more about opportunities at Deloitte? Visit www.deloitte.com/ch/careers . How to apply We look forward to hearing from you! Please click on “apply now” to submit a complete application, including CV, cover letter, references and degree certificates. If you have any questions, please contact Sidorela at talent@deloitte.ch *We consider all qualified applicants for employment regardless of race, ethnicity, religious beliefs, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability, in accordance with applicable law. Research shows that women are less likely to apply for roles unless they match all the criteria; don’t hold yourself back – apply today. We do not accept applications from recruitment agencies for this position. descriptionByLocale.it:
Posizione: Zurich Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100% Trovare il talento che rende Deloitte unico Drive the Progress of Controls Transformation Lavorare con il team Controls Transformation significa aiutare i nostri clienti a raggiungere i loro obiettivi di performance aziendali utilizzando diverse tecniche e l'ultima tecnologia per costruire quadri di controllo interni intelligenti, snelle ed efficienti che soddisfano le esigenze del business e il mondo digitale del futuro. Le vostre attività quotidiane possono includere la fornitura di progetti relativi alla trasformazione dei controlli a livello operativo e strategico e la consulenza ai clienti su come sfruttare le funzionalità ERP, principalmente SAP S/4HANA, per ottimizzare la progettazione dei controlli interni. Come si può fare un impatto · Consigli ai clienti sulle opportunità di miglioramento dei controlli che mirano ad abbracciare la tecnologia, come le funzionalità ERP (SAP S/4HANA) · Supportare i clienti nella trasformazione del loro quadro di controllo interno, pur rimanendo conformi · Progetti leader, coprendo tutti gli aspetti della fornitura di impegno; da scoping, programma e selezione di team, attraverso la consegna, il rischio & la gestione della qualità · Supporta le iniziative di go-to-market Il tedesco sarebbe molto vantaggioso. Il nostro team Controls Transformation è uno dei più veloci in crescita in Deloitte Svizzera. Così, possiamo offrire una crescita della carriera senza rivali e opportunità di apprendimento, nonché un posto emozionante per lavorare. I candidati di successo avranno l'opportunità di aiutarci a plasmare il futuro della conformità, sviluppare ulteriormente la nostra offerta di mercato e lavorare a stretto contatto con le organizzazioni top del mondo sul loro percorso di trasformazione dei controlli. Carriere a Deloitte. Scegli il tuo impatto. A Deloitte, le tue idee creano impatto e scatenano cambiamenti significativi per i nostri clienti, persone e società. La vostra esperienza, background e prospettiva unica ci aiuta a trovare nuovi modi nelle sfide più complesse in modo da poter illuminare i futuri di quelli che il nostro lavoro colpisce. A Deloitte, puoi costruire una carriera che ti ispira e ti stimola. A Deloitte, puoi scegliere il tuo impatto. In Svizzera, forniamo servizi specifici per il settore nei settori Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. Con quasi 3.000 dipendenti in sei sedi, serviamo aziende e organizzazioni di tutte le dimensioni in tutti i settori industriali.
• Offriamo lavoro significativo e stimolante, un ambiente inclusivo e di supporto in cui si può essere il vostro migliore sé e dove non smetterete mai di crescere. Potrai beneficiare di condizioni di lavoro flessibili e ibridi, il benessere e i programmi genitoriali, così come molte opportunità per collegare, collaborare e imparare. Unisciti a noi e entra a far parte di una rete globale di persone affini dedicate a fare la differenza, sia affrontando il cambiamento climatico o migliorando 100 milioni di futures entro il 2030. Vuoi saperne di più sulle opportunità a Deloitte? Visitate www.deloitte.com/ch/careers . Non vediamo l'ora di sentire da voi! Si prega di fare clic su “applica ora” per inviare una domanda completa, tra cui CV, lettera di copertura, riferimenti e certificati di laurea. Se hai domande, contatta Sidorela all'indirizzo talent@deloitte.ch * Consideriamo tutti i candidati qualificati per l'occupazione indipendentemente da razza, etnia, credenze religiose, sesso, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, origine nazionale, età o disabilità, in conformità con la legge applicabile. La ricerca mostra che le donne sono meno propensi a candidarsi per i ruoli a meno che non corrispondano a tutti i criteri; non trattenetevi indietro – si applicano oggi. Non accettiamo domande da agenzie di reclutamento per questa posizione. Deloitte Consulting AG e Deloitte AG sono affiliati a Deloitte NSE LLP, società membro di Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu Limited, società privata britannica limitata dalla garanzia (“DTTL”)

descriptionByLocale.de:
Standort: Zurich Work Pattern Prozentsatz: 80-100% Das Talent zu finden, das Deloitte einzigartig macht Drive the Progress of Controls Transformation Mit dem Controls Transformation Team helfen Sie unseren Kunden, ihre Geschäftsziele zu erreichen, indem Sie verschiedene Techniken und die neueste Technologie einsetzen, um intelligente, schlanke und effiziente interne Kontrollrahmen aufzubauen, die den Anforderungen des Unternehmens sowie der digitalen Welt der Zukunft gerecht werden. Ihre täglichen Aufgaben können die Bereitstellung von Projekten im Zusammenhang mit der Transformation von Kontrollen auf operativer und strategischer Ebene sowie die Beratung von Kunden umfassen, wie Sie die ERP-Funktionalitäten, hauptsächlich SAP S/4HANA, nutzen können, um die Gestaltung interner Kontrollen zu optimieren. Wie Sie Einfluss nehmen können · Beratung von Kunden bei Möglichkeiten zur Verbesserung der Kontrollen, die darauf abzielen, Technologien wie ERP-Funktionalitäten (SAP S/4HANA) zu nutzen · Unterstützung von Kunden bei der Transformation ihres internen Kontrollrahmens, während sie konform bleiben · Leitung von Projekten, die alle Aspekte der Bereitstellung von Engagement abdecken; von Scoping, Programm- und Teamauswahl bis hin zu Lieferung, Risiko- und Qualitätsmanagement · Unterstützung von SAP Internal Controls Go-to-Market-Initiativen und die Zusammenarbeit zwischen multidisziplinären Teams, um neue Marktangebote zu entwickeln und bestehende weiterzuentwickeln · Leitung, Inspiration, Entwicklung und Coaching des Teams Wer wir suchen · Sie sind organisiert, verfügen über starke zwischenmenschliche Fähigkeiten und ausgezeichnete Kommunikationsfähigkeiten, die es Ihnen ermöglichen, gute Beziehungen zu Kunden aufzubauen und andere in einer beratenden Rolle zu verwalten · Sie haben ein gutes Verständnis der wichtigsten SAP S/4HANA-Geschäftsprozesse und wie Sie die neuen Funktionen für Compliance- und interne Kontrollen nutzen können · Sie sind vertraut mit automatisierten Kontrollen in Form von ERP-Konfigurationen · Sie haben gute Kenntnisse über die Kerngeschäftsprozesse (z. B. PTP, OTC, RTR, Treasury, Tax, HR usw.) und verwandte wichtige Risikomanagement Deutsch wäre sehr vorteilhaft. Unser Controls Transformation Team ist eines der am schnellsten wachsenden in Deloitte Schweiz. So können wir einzigartige Karriere- und Lernmöglichkeiten sowie einen aufregenden Arbeitsplatz bieten. Erfolgreiche Kandidaten erhalten die Möglichkeit, uns zu helfen, die Zukunft der Compliance zu gestalten, unser Marktangebot weiterzuentwickeln und eng mit den weltweit führenden Organisationen auf ihrer Transformationsreise zusammenzuarbeiten. Karriere bei Deloitte. Wähle deine Wirkung. Bei Deloitte erzeugen Ihre Ideen Wirkung und bewirken bedeutende Veränderungen für unsere Kunden, Menschen und die Gesellschaft. Ihre einzigartige Expertise, Ihr Hintergrund und Ihre Perspektive helfen uns, neue Wege in die komplexesten Herausforderungen zu finden, damit wir die Zukunft derer, die unsere Arbeit beeinflusst, erhellen können. Mit knapp 3.000 Mitarbeitern an sechs Standorten betreuen wir Unternehmen und Organisationen jeder Größe in allen Branchen.

Vos tâches quotidiennes peuvent comprendre la réalisation de projets liés aux contrôles de transformation au niveau opérationnel et stratégique et des conseils aux clients sur la façon de tirer parti des fonctionnalités ERP, principalement SAP S/4HANA, pour optimiser la conception des contrôles internes. jobs.description:
Location : Zurich Work Pattern Percentage : 80-100% Help our clients to improve the efficiency and effectiveness of their companies Join our Performance Improvement and Restructuring team and play a pivotal role in shaping the future of our clients' businesses. Collaborate closely with Deloitte experts from legal, tax and regulatory services to bring tailored solutions to our clients. We are dedicated to nurturing and expanding your skills from day one, ensuring you stay at the forefront of this dynamic landscape. How you can make an impact
• Support our dedicated core team to 'own' our clients’ challenges and to meet their needs with practical hands-on solutions. These include e.g. performance improvement, strategic option analyses, managed exits, refinancings, legal entity consolidations.
• Conduct qualitative and quantitative research and develop insights. Draft input to client reports (e.g. status updates, restructuring options) and prepare financial analyses e.g. to shareholders, financing institutions or regulators.
• Help our team project manage timelines, cost, resources and deliverables and be responsible for tracking.
• Support the growth of our offering by contributing to our business development activities and quality/risk procedures.
• Share your ideas, enthusiasm, and investigative insights to drive our projects forward and own your own deliverables. Who We Are Looking For
• You are a curious generalist with a strong ability to listen and to explain complex matters in a relatable and understandable way. You enjoy orchestrating the path to a solution with many different contributors and working out practical solutions.
• You have a good understanding of financial statements, are confident in working in excel and power point to generate meaningful insights aimed at enabling decision-making in high-pressure environments.
• You are open-minded to join our journey to reshape how we work – AI is part of how we get things done.
• You have the following qualifications:
• Master’s degree with special focus on finance, banking, business administration, accounting, economics or law.
• 3+ years’ work experience in an area like strategy, transformation, transaction services, management consulting or similar (at consultant level).
• Fluency in German and English with knowledge of financial terminology. Other languages are a plus, preferably French. Your Team Experience our friendly, collaborative and international environment with plenty of room for you to connect to other people, grow and be yourself. Our team works collaboratively within cross-functional teams that are composed of a diverse group of specialists across multiple disciplines from both within our consulting practice globally and from our clients. Join our growing, multicultural team at our office in Zurich. We offer a role with exposure to global clients across different industries and the opportunity to grow and learn both on the job, as well as with our Deloitte training programs. How to apply We look forward to hearing from you! Please click on “apply now” to submit a complete application, including CV, cover letter, references and degree certificates. If you have any questions, please contact Lucrezia at talent@deloitte.ch *We consider all qualified applicants for employment regardless of race, ethnicity, religious beliefs, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability, in accordance with applicable law. Research shows that women are less likely to apply for roles unless they match all the criteria; don’t hold yourself back – apply today. descriptionByLocale.it:
Percentuale: 80-100% Aiuta i nostri clienti a migliorare l'efficienza e l'efficacia delle loro aziende Unisciti al nostro team di Performance Improvement and Restructuring e gioca un ruolo fondamentale nella definizione del futuro delle aziende dei nostri clienti. Collabora a stretto contatto con gli esperti Deloitte di servizi legali, fiscali e normativi per portare soluzioni personalizzate ai nostri clienti. Siamo dedicati a nutrire e ampliare le vostre competenze dal primo giorno, assicurandovi di rimanere all'avanguardia di questo paesaggio dinamico. Come si può fare un impatto
• Sostenere il nostro team core dedicato a 'propri' le sfide dei nostri clienti' e per soddisfare le loro esigenze con soluzioni pratiche hands-on. Questi includono, ad esempio, il miglioramento delle prestazioni, analisi delle opzioni strategiche, uscite gestite, rifinanziamenti, consolidamenti delle entità legali.
• Condurre ricerca qualitativa e quantitativa e sviluppare approfondimenti. Progetto di input ai rapporti dei clienti (ad esempio aggiornamenti di stato, opzioni di ristrutturazione) e preparazione di analisi finanziarie, ad esempio agli azionisti, agli istituti di finanziamento o ai regolatori.
• Aiuta il nostro progetto di squadra a gestire le linee temporali, i costi, le risorse e i responsabili del monitoraggio.
• Sostenere la crescita della nostra offerta contribuendo alle nostre attività di sviluppo aziendale e procedure di qualità/rischio.
• Condividi le tue idee, l'entusiasmo e le tue intuizioni investigative per portare avanti i nostri progetti e possedere i tuoi prodotti. Chi stiamo cercando
• Sei un curioso generalista con una forte capacità di ascoltare e di spiegare questioni complesse in modo relabile e comprensibile. Ti piace orchestrare il percorso di una soluzione con molti diversi contributori e lavorare soluzioni pratiche.
• Avete una buona comprensione del bilancio, siete sicuri di lavorare in Excel e punto di potere per generare intuizioni significative finalizzate a consentire il processo decisionale in ambienti ad alta pressione.

jobs.description:
Location: Zurich, Geneva Switzerland Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100% Help transform our clients’ organisations to support their business strategy Deloitte's Human Capital Consulting practice in Switzerland is at the forefront of transforming how organizations attract, develop, and retain their most valuable asset—their people. We partner with leading Swiss and international companies to reimagine their HR operating models, implement cutting-edge HR technology solutions, and build future-ready organizations. Our team combines deep HR expertise with advanced technology knowledge to deliver transformational outcomes across strategy, technology, and organizational change. We work across diverse industries and geographies, helping clients navigate the evolving world of work, embrace digital innovation, and unlock the full potential of their workforce. We are the largest Human Capital practice in the Swiss market and are widely recognized by our clients for our ability to walk in their shoes as a true partner, bring leading insight, expertise and consistently deliver high quality work. How you can make an impact As a Senior Consultant in our HR Strategy & Technology practice, you will be a trusted advisor and technical leader on SAP SuccessFactors implementations and HR transformation initiatives. You will:
• Support SAP SuccessFactors Engagements - Own the design, configuration, and deployment of SAP SuccessFactors modules across core HR, talent management, learning, compensation, or analytics modules
• Manage Complex Client Relationships - Build and maintain strategic partnerships with key stakeholders, serving as the primary point of contact for complex, high-value engagements
• Deliver Business Value - Translate client business challenges into innovative SAP SuccessFactors solutions that drive measurable outcomes in talent acquisition, performance management, learning, and organizational effectiveness
• Drive Best Practice Implementation - Leverage your knowledge of SAP SuccessFactors to establish best practices, optimize configurations, and ensure successful adoption across client organizations
• Contribute to Thought Leadership - Develop insights on HR technology trends, publish thought leadership content, and represent Deloitte at industry events and client forums
• Shape Our Practice - Contribute to the growth and evolution of our HR SAP SuccessFactors practice in Switzerland, helping us stay at the forefront of HR technology innovation Who are we looking for?
• You have a University degree, an advanced degree (Master's, MBA, or equivalent) is a plus
• Minimum 4 years of professional experience with SAP SuccessFactors implementations, including hands-on configuration and deployment
• Demonstrated expertise across multiple SAP SuccessFactors modules (Core HR, Talent Management, Learning, Compensation, Analytics, or similar)
• Strong understanding of HR processes, organizational structures, and how technology enables HR transformation
• You are an incisive thinker, confident with concepts, analysis and frameworks, with the ability to structure work and deliver under pressure
• You have a passion for including technology, data and behavioural science into structuring the future of how organisations are structured and work
• Genuine interest in understanding client needs and delivering value; ability to build rapport with stakeholders at all levels. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with clients and internal teams.
• Fluency in written and spoken English and German is essential; proficiency in additional languages such as French is an advantage
• Willingness to travel within Switzerland and internationally as required. Your team Become part of a diverse, multinational and highly motivated team. We will help you grow both personally and professionally: through our trainings, mentoring programmes and on-the-job learning, but also by connecting with your colleagues across all business lines. Life at Deloitte At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact. In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors. We offer meaningful and challenging work, an inclusive and supportive environment where you can be your best self and where you will never stop growing. You will benefit from flexible and hybrid working conditions, wellbeing and parental programmes as well as many opportunities to connect, collaborate and learn. Join us and become part of a global network of like-minded people dedicated to making a difference, whether by addressing climate change or improving 100 million futures by 2030. Want to know more about opportunities at Deloitte? Visit www.deloitte.com/ch/careers . How to apply We look forward to hearing from you! Location: Basel, Geneva, Zurich Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100% Aiuta i nostri clienti ad allineare gli obiettivi strategici di business con l'innovazione AI per sbloccare il valore trasformativo Deloitte AI & Data consente ai clienti di sfruttare l'IA e i dati non solo come asset tecnologici, ma come abilitatori strategici che guidano la crescita aziendale e il vantaggio competitivo. • Gestion des données:

jobs.description:
Location: Basel, Zurich, Geneva Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100% Help our clients navigate the future with confidence and embrace decision making with clear data-driven choices Deloitte AI & Data helps clients unlock the power of AI and data to deliver better human-centric solutions that catalyse growth and efficiencies. We enable them to leverage data, analytics, modern platforms, and data science & AI technologies to uncover hidden relationships from vast troves of data, generate insights, and inform their decision-making. We help clients transform their business by designing and implementing data solutions to excel in their markets. Our role is to understand their business problems and use data-driven thinking and technology to achieve outcomes that drive their business forward. How you can make an impact
• Develop data strategies that allow our clients to reach their business objectives across regulatory, cost, and revenue pillars.
• Design complex data & analytics transformations by providing architectural, technical and organizational thought leadership and guide clients in executing these transformations, which have significant organizational implications.
• Drive Data & AI use cases from business value concept to production
• Develop and maintain trusted client relationships through project work or business development and expand your network both internally and externally.
• Support business development opportunities to generate new projects.
• Be a role model for people you work with by demonstrating strong work ethic, leadership, and subject matter competence.
• Grow expertise in different industry and subject matter areas and share your knowledge with the rest of Deloitte talent. What We Are Looking For: Drive and Motivation:
• Passionate individuals looking to make a career in Consulting.
• Ability to manage multiple activities in a high-paced environment and deliver independently. Consulting and Communication Skills:
• Strong Microsoft Power Point skills: Ability to design and shape meaningful presentations.
• Strong Conceptual Capability: Ability to consolidate diverse requirements into coherent solution designs, simplifying complex problems.
• Business-IT Translator: Proficient in leading requirement analysis and acting as the bridge between business needs and technical solutions
• Team Collaboration and Leadership: Proven ability to guide nearshore and offshore technical implementation teams, ensuring effective collaboration and project success.
• Technical Integration: Skilful in integrating system components, providing clear business explanations, and leading technical workshops. Technical Expertise:
• Strong Engineering and/or Mathematics background.
• Solid experience with Python. Experience with R is a plus.
• Experience delivering Generative AI, AI, Machine Learning and/or Analytics solutions on one or more of the cloud services providers: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Azure or Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
• Familiarity with Large Language Models (LLMs) and adjacent services required to bring use cases to production on one or more of the cloud service providers above is highly preferred.
• Experience with data science workbench tools such as Snowflake, Databricks and Dataiku is a plus.
• Experience with Data Visualization tools such as PowerBI and Tableau is a plus. Language Proficiency:
• Fluent in English; fluency in German and/or French is highly preferred to facilitate communication with diverse teams and stakeholders. Industry Experience:
• At least 3 years of practical experience in consulting, tech companies, or industry-specific roles, particularly in data-driven fields.
• Previous experience in the Banking, Insurance, Life Science or Healthcare sector is advantageous. Your team Become part of a diverse and multinational team of 50+ highly motivated individuals located in our Zurich, Geneva, or Basel offices. We specialise in AI & data - how to structure it, how to source it, how to transform it, how to store it, and how to consume it. Join our fast-paced and fun team, working alongside highly talented colleagues on varied and exciting projects, with access to excellent and continuous learning opportunities. Deloitte AI & Data is the leading data & analytics consulting team in Switzerland. You will have a chance to work with outstanding colleagues and have access to variety of clients, vendors, and technologies. Our business is growing fast and there are plenty market opportunities to develop career in the direction that you want. We will help you grow both personally and professionally: through our trainings, mentoring programmes, and on-the-job learning, but also by working with clients and vendors across different industries. Careers at Deloitte. Choose your impact. At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact. In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors. We offer meaningful and challenging work, an inclusive and supportive environment where you can be your best self and where you will never stop growing. You will benefit from flexible and hybrid working conditions, wellbeing and parental programmes as well as many opportunities to connect, collaborate and learn. Join us and become part of a global network of like-minded people dedicated to making a difference, whether by addressing climate change or improving 100 million futures by 2030. Want to know more about opportunities at Deloitte? Visit www.deloitte.com/ch/careers . How to apply We look forward to hearing from you! Please click on “apply now” to submit a complete application, including CV, cover letter, references and degree certificates. If you have any questions, please contact Aarabi at talent@deloitte.ch *All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability, in accordance with applicable law. We do not accept applications from recruitment agencies for this position. • Un posto di lavoro sicuro con zero tolleranza per molestie.
• Ambienti aperti dove le persone sono libere di essere se stesse.
• Una comunità inclusiva che crede nel rispetto e nel merito. Ubicazione: Basilea, Zurigo, Ginevra Percentuale di lavoro: 80-100% Aiuta i nostri clienti a navigare in futuro con fiducia e ad abbracciare il processo decisionale con chiare scelte basate sui dati Deloitte AI & Data aiuta i clienti a sbloccare il potere dell'IA e i dati per fornire soluzioni umane-centriche migliori che catalizzano la crescita e le efficienze. Gli consentiamo di sfruttare i dati, le analisi, le piattaforme moderne e le tecnologie dell'informatica e dell'intelligenza artificiale per scoprire le relazioni nascoste da vasti dati, generare intuizioni e informare il loro processo decisionale. Aiutiamo i clienti a trasformare il loro business progettando e implementando soluzioni di dati per eccellere nei loro mercati. Il nostro ruolo è quello di capire i loro problemi di business e utilizzare il pensiero e la tecnologia data-driven per raggiungere i risultati che portano avanti il loro business. Come si può fare un impatto
• Sviluppare strategie di dati che permettono ai nostri clienti di raggiungere i loro obiettivi di business attraverso i pilastri di regolazione, costi e ricavi.
• Progettazione di dati complessi e trasformazioni di analisi fornendo la leadership di pensiero architettonica, tecnica e organizzativa e guidare i clienti nell'esecuzione di queste trasformazioni, che hanno implicazioni organizzative significative.
• Drive Data & AI utilizza casi dal concetto di valore aziendale alla produzione
• Sviluppare e mantenere relazioni client affidabili attraverso il lavoro di progetto o lo sviluppo aziendale e espandere la rete sia internamente che esternamente.
• Supporto opportunità di sviluppo aziendale per generare nuovi progetti.
• Sii un modello di ruolo per le persone con cui lavori dimostrando una forte etica del lavoro, leadership e competenza di materia.
• Crescere competenze in diversi settori industriali e materie e condividere le vostre conoscenze con il resto del talento Deloitte. Cosa stiamo cercando: Guidare e Motivazione:
• Persone appassionati che cercano di fare una carriera in Consulenza.
• Capacità di gestire più attività in un ambiente ad alta velocità e fornire indipendentemente. Competenze di consulenza e comunicazione:
• Forte competenze Microsoft Power Point: Capacità di progettare e modellare presentazioni significative.
• Forte capacità concettuale: capacità di consolidare diversi requisiti in progetti di soluzioni coerenti, semplificando i problemi complessi.
• Traduttore Business-IT: Proficiente nell'analisi dei requisiti e nell'agire come ponte tra le esigenze aziendali e le soluzioni tecniche
• Team Collaboration and Leadership: comprovata capacità di guidare i team di implementazione tecnica vicino terra e off-shore, garantendo una collaborazione efficace e un successo del progetto.
• Integrazione Tecnica: Abile nell'integrazione di componenti di sistema, fornendo chiari spiegazioni aziendali e principali workshop tecnici. Competenza tecnica:
• Forte Ingegneria e/o sfondo matematico.
• Esperienza solida con Python. L'esperienza con R è un vantaggio.
• Esperienza nella fornitura di soluzioni Generative AI, AI, Machine Learning e/o Analytics su uno o più fornitori di servizi cloud: Amazon Web Services (AWS), Azure o Google Cloud Platform (GCP).
• La familiarità con i modelli di lingua grande (LLMs) e i servizi adiacenti necessari per portare casi di utilizzo alla produzione su uno o più dei fornitori di servizi cloud di cui sopra è altamente preferito.
• Esperienza con strumenti di banco di lavoro della scienza dei dati come Snowflake, Databricks e Dataiku è un plus.
• Esperienza con strumenti di visualizzazione dati come PowerBI e Tableau è un plus. Proficienza linguistica:
• Fluente in inglese; la fluenza in tedesco e/o francese è molto preferita per facilitare la comunicazione con diversi team e stakeholder. Esperienza del settore:
• Almeno 3 anni di esperienza pratica nella consulenza, nelle aziende tecnologiche o nei ruoli specifici del settore, in particolare nei settori dei dati.
• L'esperienza precedente nel settore bancario, assicurativo, scienze della vita o sanità è vantaggiosa. Il vostro team fa parte di un team diversificato e multinazionale di 50+ individui altamente motivati situati nei nostri uffici di Zurigo, Ginevra o Basilea. Siamo specializzati in dati AI & - come strutturarlo, come fonte, come trasformarlo, come memorizzarlo e come consumarlo. Unisciti al nostro team veloce e divertente, lavorando insieme a colleghi di grande talento su progetti diversi ed emozionanti, con l'accesso a eccellenti e continue opportunità di apprendimento. Deloitte AI & Data è il principale team di consulenza dati e analisi in Svizzera. Avrete la possibilità di lavorare con colleghi eccezionali e avere accesso a varietà di clienti, fornitori e tecnologie. Il nostro business sta crescendo velocemente e ci sono molte opportunità di mercato per sviluppare la carriera nella direzione che si desidera. Vi aiuteremo a crescere sia personalmente che professionalmente: attraverso i nostri corsi di formazione, programmi di mentoring, e l'apprendimento on-the-job, ma anche lavorando con clienti e fornitori in diversi settori. Carriere a Deloitte. Scegli il tuo impatto. A Deloitte, le tue idee creano impatto e scatenano cambiamenti significativi per i nostri clienti, persone e società. La vostra esperienza, background e prospettiva unica ci aiuta a trovare nuovi modi nelle sfide più complesse in modo da poter illuminare i futuri di quelli che il nostro lavoro colpisce. A Deloitte, puoi costruire una carriera che ti ispira e ti stimola. A Deloitte, puoi scegliere il tuo impatto. In Svizzera, forniamo servizi specifici per il settore nei settori Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. Con quasi 3.000 dipendenti in sei sedi, serviamo aziende e organizzazioni di tutte le dimensioni in tutti i settori industriali. Offriamo lavoro significativo e stimolante, un ambiente inclusivo e di supporto in cui si può essere il vostro migliore sé e dove non smetterete mai di crescere. Potrai beneficiare di condizioni di lavoro flessibili e ibridi, il benessere e i programmi genitoriali, così come molte opportunità per collegare, collaborare e imparare. Unisciti a noi e entra a far parte di una rete globale di persone affini dedicate a fare la differenza, sia affrontando il cambiamento climatico o migliorando 100 milioni di futures entro il 2030. Vuoi saperne di più sulle opportunità a Deloitte? Visitate www.deloitte.com/ch/careers . Non vediamo l'ora di sentire da voi! Si prega di fare clic su “applica ora” per inviare una domanda completa, tra cui CV, lettera di copertura, riferimenti e certificati di laurea. Se avete domande, si prega di contattare Aarabi a talent@deloitte.ch *Tutti i candidati qualificati riceveranno considerazione per l'occupazione senza riguardo a razza, colore, religione, sesso, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, origine nazionale, età o disabilità, in conformità con la legge applicabile. Non accettiamo domande da agenzie di reclutamento per questa posizione. • Ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz mit null Toleranz für Belästigung.
• Offene Umgebungen, in denen Menschen frei sind, sie selbst zu sein.
• Eine inklusive Gemeinschaft, die an Respekt und Verdienst glaubt. Standort: Basel, Zürich, Genf Arbeitsmuster Prozentsatz: 80-100% Helfen Sie unseren Kunden, mit Vertrauen in die Zukunft zu navigieren und Entscheidungen mit klaren datengesteuerten Entscheidungen zu treffen Deloitte AI & Data hilft Kunden, die Leistungsfähigkeit von KI und Daten zu nutzen, um bessere menschenzentrierte Lösungen zu liefern, die Wachstum und Effizienz katalysieren. Wir ermöglichen es ihnen, Daten, Analysen, moderne Plattformen und Data Science & AI-Technologien zu nutzen, um versteckte Beziehungen aus riesigen Datenquellen aufzudecken, Erkenntnisse zu generieren und ihre Entscheidungsfindung zu informieren. Wir helfen Kunden, ihr Geschäft zu transformieren, indem wir Datenlösungen entwerfen und implementieren, um in ihren Märkten zu übertreffen. Unsere Aufgabe ist es, ihre Geschäftsprobleme zu verstehen und datengesteuertes Denken und Technologie zu nutzen, um Ergebnisse zu erzielen, die ihr Geschäft vorantreiben. Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen können
• Entwicklung von Datenstrategien, die es unseren Kunden ermöglichen, ihre Geschäftsziele über regulatorische, Kosten- und Umsatzsäulen hinweg zu erreichen.

jobs.description:
Location: Zurich Work Pattern Percentage: 60-100% Our Audit & Assurance Team is working on finance transformation and accounting advisory projects and delivers internal and external audit engagements. We are collaborating closely across all Service Lines of Deloitte to help our global and diverse customers to achieve their corporate goals, manage their risks and improve their business performance. Do you have strong skills in insurance accounting and reporting, a strong audit or insurance industry background and ready to help our clients in addressing the complex challenges faced by their finance teams? Then we are the right company for you. Are you looking to return to the workplace after an extended career break? We provide tailored coaching and support for this role, specifically designed for returners to help refresh your knowledge and skills and ease your transition back into the workplace after an extended career break. If this applies to you, please inform your recruiter when submitting your application. What you can expect from us
• You advise clients on the implementation of internal control frameworks, finance transformation and new International Financial Reporting Standards (IFRS & US GAAP) of particular importance to the Insurance Industry.
• You will conduct external audit engagements for both national and international insurance clients, ensuring compliance with relevant national / international reporting standards and regulatory requirements.
• You will help the clients incorporate new regulatory requirements and related processes into their daily business and prepare their systems through testing the clients in harmonizing of existing and development of new reporting processes for financial and non-financial data in (re)insurance
• You will conduct internal audits and FINMA regulatory assignments for Insurance and Reinsurance companies Your qualifications
• You are currently pursuing your Swiss CPA or ACCA qualification and have 2 to 5 years of practical experience in accounting or auditing within the financial services sector
• You have a minimum of 2 years of experience in external auditing in the insurance field, ideally at one of the Big 4, or minimum 3 years of experience with an insurance company’s accounting/reporting function
• You are a team player and able to work well with individuals from other areas and with customers to build up customer relationships
• You communicate confidently in English as well as German. Any further languages would be an advantage Your team Become part of a diverse, multinational and highly motivated team of 22 at our Zurich office. We will help you grow both personally and professionally: through our trainings, mentoring programmes and on-the-job learning, but also by connecting with your colleagues across all business lines. Careers at Deloitte. Choose your impact. At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact. In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. With more than 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors. We offer meaningful and challenging work, an inclusive and supportive environment where you can be your best self and where you will never stop growing. You will benefit from flexible and hybrid working conditions, wellbeing and parental programmes as well as many opportunities to connect, collaborate and learn. Join us and become part of a global network of like-minded people dedicated to making a difference, whether by addressing climate change or improving 100 million futures by 2030. Want to know more about opportunities at Deloitte? Visit www.deloitte.com/ch/careers . How to apply We look forward to hearing from you! Please click on “apply now” to submit a complete application, including CV, cover letter, references and degree certificates. If you have any questions, please contact Nadia at talent@deloitte.ch *We consider all qualified applicants for employment regardless of race, ethnicity, religious beliefs, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability, in accordance with applicable law. • Hai un accreditamento professionale attuariale o equivalente, o sei determinato a guadagnarne uno.
• Siete eccitati dall'impatto, e scavate più in profondità, sfidare le assunzioni, e trovare soluzioni altre manca, qualità che importa ancora di più quando nessun due progetti guardano lo stesso.
• Capisci come il lavoro attuariale si nutre di rendiconti finanziari e posizioni di capitale in ambito internazionale e svizzero, e può applicare tale conoscenza in pratica.
• Capite il paesaggio assicurativo e pensionistico svizzero e portate familiarità con altre giurisdizioni, dandovi una prospettiva genuinamente internazionale.
• Fluency in inglese e tedesco è essenziale per collaborare senza soluzione di continuità attraverso i nostri clienti e team internazionali diversi. Unisciti a un team multinazionale nel nostro ufficio di Zurigo dove la collaborazione e la crescita vanno di pari passo. Al di là del vostro team immediato, vi collegherete con i colleghi attraverso le nostre linee di business, costruendo relazioni e espandendo la vostra prospettiva in una cultura solida e inclusiva.
