jobs.description:
Location : Geneva, Zurich Switzerland Work Pattern Percentage : 80-100% Duration : 6 months Help our clients solve the biggest challenges of their IT organisation In our Technology Strategy & Transformation Team, our expertise is rooted in a deep understanding of technology coupled with excellent communications skills and broader business understanding. We work together with some of the largest organisations in Switzerland and the world to introduce the change that really makes an impact for their business. Would you like to be part of a team that helps a world-leading bank on its journey to establish the largest European wealth management entity, standardizing and enhancing the customer experience across all key markets in Europe? Or would you like to develop the commercial strategy for a Swiss chemical company across its global markets, building customer segmentation and a channel operating model to address challenging local market conditions? Then join our Technology Strategy & Transformation Team! How you can make an impact
• As an Intern, you will gain hands-on experience from day one, supporting our client engagements to solve their most pressing challenges and opportunities. In this role, you will be mainly responsible for:
• Work in a client-facing role on projects in key industries
• Be integrated into a project team from the start and work in partnership with the customer and - with support from experienced colleagues - on challenging problems and solutions
• Get involved in projects that span across IT Strategy and Operating Model design, IT Architecture, IT Business Management, IT Agility Advisory, IT Transitions and Transformations, IT M&A Conduct analysis, take part in workshops and status meetings and prepare documents and presentations Who are we looking for?
• You are a recent graduate or a high performing student completing your Master’s degree in the field of Information Systems, Business and/or Engineering with exposure to IT topics
• You have a strong eagerness to learn and foundational exposure to IT topics, previous internships or work experience within IT Consulting or an IT department of a global company is desirable but not essential
• You have a passion for IT innovation and awareness of major technology trends (Agile Methodology, Robotics Process Automation, Cloud, etc.)
• You enjoy working methodically, in a structured way and with great attention to detail
• You are curious and have a thirst for knowledge, bringing a fresh perspective in what you do
• You communicate confidently in English and German or French Your team At Deloitte, our Technology Strategy & Transformation specialists help organizations develop the strategies and implement the systems that build business value and drive performance. We have the in-depth knowledge and experience gained from working on some of the most complex IT challenges around the globe, everything from system replacement to full IT transformation. We take your further development seriously. We offers a comprehensive internal and external training programme (e.g. several certifications like ITIL, SAFe, PRINCE2). Life at Deloitte At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact. In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors. We offer meaningful and challenging work, an inclusive and supportive environment where you can be your best self and where you will never stop growing. You will benefit from flexible and hybrid working conditions, wellbeing and parental programmes as well as many opportunities to connect, collaborate and learn. Join us and become part of a global network of like-minded people dedicated to making a difference, whether by addressing climate change or improving 100 million futures by 2030. Want to know more about opportunities at Deloitte? Visit www.apply.deloitte.ch . How to apply We look forward to hearing from you! Please click on "apply now" to submit a complete application, including CV, cover letter, references and degree certificates. If you have any questions, please contact Pieter-Jan at talent@deloitte.ch . *We consider all qualified applicants for employment regardless of race, ethnicity, religious beliefs, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability, in accordance with applicable law. • Essere integrato in un team di progetto fin dall'inizio e lavorare in collaborazione con il cliente e - con il supporto di colleghi esperti - su problemi e soluzioni impegnative

• Hai una passione per l'innovazione IT e la consapevolezza delle principali tendenze tecnologiche (Agile Methodology, Robotics Process Automation, Cloud, ecc.)
• Ti piace lavorare metodicamente, in modo strutturato e con grande attenzione ai dettagli
• Siete curiosi e avete sete di sapere, portando una nuova prospettiva in quello che fate
• Voi comunicate con fiducia in inglese e tedesco o francese Il vostro team A Deloitte, i nostri specialisti di Technology Strategy & Transformation aiutano le organizzazioni a sviluppare le strategie e implementare i sistemi che costruiscono valore aziendale e prestazioni di azionamento. Abbiamo la conoscenza approfondita e l'esperienza acquisita lavorando su alcune delle sfide IT più complesse in tutto il mondo, tutto, dalla sostituzione del sistema alla trasformazione IT completa. Prendiamo seriamente il vostro ulteriore sviluppo. Offriamo un programma completo di formazione interna ed esterna (ad esempio diverse certificazioni come ITIL, SAFe, PRINCE2). Vita a Deloitte A Deloitte, le tue idee creano impatto e innescano cambiamenti significativi per i nostri clienti, persone e società. La vostra esperienza, background e prospettiva unica ci aiuta a trovare nuovi modi nelle sfide più complesse in modo da poter illuminare i futuri di quelli che il nostro lavoro colpisce. A Deloitte, puoi costruire una carriera che ti ispira e ti stimola. A Deloitte, puoi scegliere il tuo impatto. In Svizzera, forniamo servizi specifici per il settore nei settori Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. Con quasi 3.000 dipendenti in sei sedi, serviamo aziende e organizzazioni di tutte le dimensioni in tutti i settori industriali. Offriamo lavoro significativo e stimolante, un ambiente inclusivo e di supporto in cui si può essere il vostro migliore sé e dove non smetterete mai di crescere. Potrai beneficiare di condizioni di lavoro flessibili e ibridi, il benessere e i programmi genitoriali, così come molte opportunità per collegare, collaborare e imparare. Unisciti a noi e entra a far parte di una rete globale di persone affini dedicate a fare la differenza, sia affrontando il cambiamento climatico o migliorando 100 milioni di futures entro il 2030. jobs.description:
Help our clients to find vulnerabilities before cyber-criminals do Do you enjoy the thrill of hacking into systems on online training platforms or bug bounty programs? Would you like to turn your passion into a career and help us protecting our clients’ systems? Do you want to kickstart your career at the global leader in cyber security consulting and grow your career as ethical hacker / penetration tester? As an ethical hacker / penetration tester, you will work with clients across various industries to ensure their applications and infrastructure are secure. You will be supported by your team who will help you to leverage your prior experience while growing and building up your penetration testing expertise and staying up to date with the latest tools, techniques, and procedures. How you can make an impact:
• Perform penetration tests for web and mobile applications and other security assessments such as code reviews where technical skills are essential
• Document your findings in a high-quality, easy to read report, present it to the client and explain the steps required for remediation
• Share your expertise as part of wider projects in the area of red teaming, IT risks and regulatory projects
• Participate in team problem solving efforts and offer ideas to solve client issues
• Support business development activities such as proposal and presentation preparation Who we are looking for:
• You have a passion for cyber security and the desire to build your Consulting career as a penetration tester in our application security team
• You participated in CTF events, hacking challenges such as Hack The Box or bug bounty programs
• You have a completed Bachelor or Master’s degree with a strong academic record in computer science or a similar field
• A good understanding of the OWASP Top 10 and penetration testing related certifications such as OSCP or OSWE are a strong advantage
• Software development skills would be a plus
• Experience in vulnerability management would be an added advantage.
• You are completely fluent in English, fluency in German is a strong advantage Your team Become part of an entrepreneurial, innovative and international team of 60 Cyber professionals across Switzerland. • Utilizzerai la tua esperienza nel fornire progetti impegnativi alla nostra base clienti, mirando a migliorare la maturità nelle aree di resilienza, inclusi ma non limitati alla gestione della continuità, alla gestione delle crisi e al recupero
• Parteciperai alle attività di sviluppo aziendale, migliorando le nostre proposte di Crisis & Resilience e costruendo nuove relazioni con i clienti Chi stiamo cercando

• Accanto a Crisis & Resilience questioni correlate – un forte interesse per imparare, crescere e contribuire a una più ampia gestione del rischio e argomenti correlati al cyber

A Deloitte, puoi costruire una carriera che ti ispira e ti stimola. A Deloitte, puoi scegliere il tuo impatto. In Svizzera, forniamo servizi specifici per il settore nei settori Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. Con quasi 3.000 dipendenti in sei sedi, serviamo aziende e organizzazioni di tutte le dimensioni in tutti i settori industriali. Offriamo lavoro significativo e stimolante, un ambiente inclusivo e di supporto in cui si può essere il vostro migliore sé e dove non smetterete mai di crescere. Potrai beneficiare di condizioni di lavoro flessibili e ibridi, il benessere e i programmi genitoriali, così come molte opportunità per collegare, collaborare e imparare. Unisciti a noi e entra a far parte di una rete globale di persone affini dedicate a fare la differenza, sia affrontando il cambiamento climatico o migliorando 100 milioni di futures entro il 2030. jobs.description:
Location: Zurich Work Pattern Percentage: 80% - 100% Our tax team is looking for you! Our Tax Team offers integrated tax services that help our customers to successfully manage local and global challenges. Do you want to advise discerning customers on different (operational) tax issues? On an entry level you will be part of our Financial Services Tax (FSI) team and take a vital role within our team of specialists, supporting them in tax advisory and compliance projects for Swiss and international banks, insurance and trust companies as well as asset managers. How you can make an impact
• Get the opportunity to be involved in activities with client contact and be responsible for cross-divisional projects in various industries from the first day.
• Get an exciting insight into our various diverse fields of projects such as national and international corporate restructurings, transactions and tax planning projects for banks, insurance companies, asset managers and investment companies as well as funds
• Develop a clear, long-term career path with internal and external professional training offers as well as the time and financial assistance necessary for the training to become a dipl. Tax expert or study the MAS FH in Swiss and International Taxation / LL.M. Swiss and International Taxation.
• Be part of an international and interdisciplinary team with plenty of learning on the job opportunities. Who We Are Looking For
• You have a Master degree, preferably in business administration, economics or law, ideally with tax knowledge
• You have a positive and pragmatic attitude as well as the willingness to take over responsibility
• You are interested in investigating complex questions and an attitude that corresponds to our most important values: be curious and bold, respectful and integrative
• You are interested in obtaining the Certified Swiss Tax Expert qualification/Master in Swiss and International Taxation/LL.M on Swiss and International Taxation
• You are a native German speaker and communicate confidently in English. Any further languages would be an advantage. Your Team Become part of a diverse, multinational and highly motivated team of 30 employees in our office in Zurich. We will help you grow both personally and professionally: through our trainings, mentoring programmes and on-the-job learning, but also by connecting with your colleagues across all business lines. Careers at Deloitte. Choose your impact. At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact. In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors. We offer meaningful and challenging work, an inclusive and supportive environment where you can be your best self and where you will never stop growing. You will benefit from flexible and hybrid working conditions, wellbeing and parental programmes as well as many opportunities to connect, collaborate and learn. Join us and become part of a global network of like-minded people dedicated to making a difference, whether by addressing climate change or improving 100 million futures by 2030. Want to know more about opportunities at Deloitte? Visit www.deloitte.com/ch/careers . How to apply We look forward to hearing from you! Please click on “apply now” to submit a complete application, including CV, cover letter, references and degree certificates. If you have any questions, please contact Lena at talent@deloitte.ch *We consider all qualified applicants for employment regardless of race, ethnicity, religious beliefs, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability, in accordance with applicable law. Research shows that women are less likely to apply for roles unless they match all the criteria; don’t hold yourself back – apply today. We do not accept applications from recruitment agencies for this position. descriptionByLocale.it:
Offriamo con orgoglio:
• Un posto di lavoro sicuro con zero tolleranza per molestie.
• Ambienti aperti dove le persone sono libere di essere se stesse.
• Una comunità inclusiva che crede nel rispetto e nel merito. Ubicazione: Percentuale di lavoro di Zurigo: 80% - 100% La nostra squadra fiscale ti sta cercando! Il nostro Tax Team offre servizi fiscali integrati che aiutano i nostri clienti a gestire con successo le sfide locali e globali. Vuoi consigliare i clienti esigenti su diverse questioni fiscali (funzionali)? A livello di entrata farai parte del nostro team di Financial Services Tax (FSI) e assumerai un ruolo vitale all'interno del nostro team di specialisti, supportandoli in progetti di consulenza fiscale e di compliance per banche svizzere e internazionali, compagnie di assicurazione e fiducia e gestori di asset. Come si può fare un impatto
• Ottenere l'opportunità di essere coinvolti in attività con il contatto cliente e essere responsabile di progetti cross-divisionali in varie industrie dal primo giorno.
• Ottieni un'emozionante conoscenza dei nostri diversi settori di progetti come ristrutturazioni, operazioni e progetti di pianificazione fiscale nazionali e internazionali per banche, compagnie assicurative, asset manager e società di investimento nonché fondi
• Sviluppare un percorso di carriera chiaro e a lungo termine con offerte di formazione professionale interna ed esterna, nonché il tempo e l'assistenza finanziaria necessari per la formazione a diventare un dipl. Esperto fiscale o studio del MAS FH in tassazione svizzera e internazionale / LL.M. Tassa svizzera e internazionale.
• Partecipa a un team internazionale e interdisciplinare con un sacco di apprendimento sulle opportunità di lavoro. Chi stiamo cercando
• Hai una laurea magistrale, preferibilmente in amministrazione aziendale, economia o legge, idealmente con la conoscenza fiscale
• Hai un atteggiamento positivo e pragmatico, così come la volontà di assumersi la responsabilità
• Sei interessato a indagare domande complesse e un atteggiamento che corrisponde ai nostri valori più importanti: essere curiosi e audaci, rispettosi e integrativi
• Sei interessato ad ottenere la certificazione Swiss Tax Expert/Master in Swiss and International Taxation/LL.M su Taxation svizzero e internazionale
• Sei un madrelingua tedesco e comunica con fiducia in inglese. Qualsiasi altra lingua sarebbe un vantaggio. Il vostro team fa parte di un team diversificato, multinazionale e altamente motivato di 30 dipendenti nel nostro ufficio a Zurigo. Vi aiuteremo a crescere sia personalmente che professionalmente: attraverso i nostri corsi di formazione, programmi di mentoring e apprendimento on-the-job, ma anche collegando i vostri colleghi in tutte le linee aziendali. Carriere a Deloitte. Scegli il tuo impatto. A Deloitte, le tue idee creano impatto e scatenano cambiamenti significativi per i nostri clienti, persone e società. La vostra esperienza, background e prospettiva unica ci aiuta a trovare nuovi modi nelle sfide più complesse in modo da poter illuminare i futuri di quelli che il nostro lavoro colpisce. A Deloitte, puoi costruire una carriera che ti ispira e ti stimola. A Deloitte, puoi scegliere il tuo impatto. In Svizzera, forniamo servizi specifici per il settore nei settori Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. Con quasi 3.000 dipendenti in sei sedi, serviamo aziende e organizzazioni di tutte le dimensioni in tutti i settori industriali. Offriamo lavoro significativo e stimolante, un ambiente inclusivo e di supporto in cui si può essere il vostro migliore sé e dove non smetterete mai di crescere. Potrai beneficiare di condizioni di lavoro flessibili e ibridi, il benessere e i programmi genitoriali, così come molte opportunità per collegare, collaborare e imparare. Unisciti a noi e entra a far parte di una rete globale di persone affini dedicate a fare la differenza, sia affrontando il cambiamento climatico o migliorando 100 milioni di futures entro il 2030. Vuoi saperne di più sulle opportunità a Deloitte? Visitate www.deloitte.com/ch/careers . Non vediamo l'ora di sentire da voi! Si prega di fare clic su “applica ora” per inviare una domanda completa, tra cui CV, lettera di copertura, riferimenti e certificati di laurea. Se hai domande, contatta Lena all'indirizzo talent@deloitte.ch * Consideriamo tutti i candidati qualificati per l'occupazione indipendentemente da razza, etnia, credenze religiose, sesso, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, origine nazionale, età o disabilità, in conformità con la legge applicabile. La ricerca mostra che le donne sono meno propensi a candidarsi per i ruoli a meno che non corrispondano a tutti i criteri; non trattenetevi indietro – si applicano oggi. Non accettiamo domande da agenzie di reclutamento per questa posizione. • Erhalten Sie einen spannenden Einblick in unsere vielfältigen Projektfelder wie nationale und internationale Unternehmensumstrukturierungen, Transaktions- und Steuerplanungsprojekte für Banken, Versicherungen, Vermögensverwalter und Investmentgesellschaften sowie Fonds

Steuerexperte oder studieren Sie die MAS FH in Swiss and International Taxation / LL.M. Swiss and International Taxation.
• Werden Sie Teil eines internationalen und interdisziplinären Teams mit viel Lernen zu den Jobmöglichkeiten. Wen wir suchen
• Sie haben einen Master-Abschluss, vorzugsweise in Betriebswirtschaft, Wirtschaft oder Recht, idealerweise mit Steuerkenntnissen
• Sie haben eine positive und pragmatische Einstellung sowie die Bereitschaft, Verantwortung zu übernehmen
• Sie interessieren sich für komplexe Fragen und eine Haltung, die unseren wichtigsten Werten entspricht: Seien Sie neugierig und mutig, respektvoll und integrativ

• Sie sind Muttersprachler und kommunizieren selbstbewusst auf Englisch. Weitere Sprachen wären von Vorteil. Nous offrons fièrement :
• Un lieu de travail sûr et une tolérance zéro pour le harcèlement.
• Des environnements ouverts où les gens sont libres d'être eux-mêmes.
• Une communauté inclusive qui croit au respect et au mérite. Lieu: Zurich Profil de travail Pourcentage: 80% - 100% Notre équipe fiscale vous cherche ! Notre équipe fiscale offre des services fiscaux intégrés qui aident nos clients à gérer avec succès les défis locaux et mondiaux. Voulez-vous conseiller des clients éclairés sur différentes questions fiscales (opérationnelles)? Au niveau d'entrée, vous ferez partie de notre équipe Fiscalité Services Financiers (FSI) et jouerez un rôle vital au sein de notre équipe de spécialistes, en les soutenant dans les projets de conseil fiscal et de conformité pour les banques suisses et internationales, les compagnies d'assurance et de fiducie ainsi que les gestionnaires d'actifs. Comment faire un impact
• Obtenez l'occasion de participer à des activités avec le contact client et d'être responsable de projets interdivisionnels dans diverses industries dès le premier jour.
• Obtenez un aperçu passionnant de nos différents domaines de projets tels que les restructurations d'entreprises nationales et internationales, les opérations et les projets de planification fiscale pour les banques, les compagnies d'assurance, les gestionnaires d'actifs et les sociétés d'investissement ainsi que les fonds
• Développer un parcours de carrière clair et à long terme avec des offres de formation professionnelle interne et externe ainsi que le temps et l'aide financière nécessaires pour que la formation devienne un dipl. Expert fiscal ou étudier le MAS FH en fiscalité suisse et internationale / LL.M. Fiscalité suisse et internationale.
• Faites partie d'une équipe internationale et interdisciplinaire avec beaucoup d'apprentissage sur les possibilités d'emploi. Qui nous cherchons
• Vous avez un Master, de préférence en administration des affaires, en économie ou en droit, idéalement avec une connaissance fiscale
• Vous avez une attitude positive et pragmatique ainsi que la volonté de prendre la responsabilité
• Vous êtes intéressé à étudier des questions complexes et une attitude qui correspond à nos valeurs les plus importantes: être curieux et audacieux, respectueux et intégratif
• Vous êtes intéressé par l'obtention de la certification Swiss Tax Expert / Master en fiscalité suisse et internationale / LL.M sur la fiscalité suisse et internationale
• Vous êtes un locuteur allemand natif et communiquez avec confiance en anglais. Toute autre langue serait un avantage. Votre équipe Faites partie d'une équipe diversifiée, multinationale et très motivée de 30 employés dans notre bureau de Zurich. Nous vous aiderons à grandir personnellement et professionnellement : grâce à nos formations, à nos programmes de mentorat et à l'apprentissage en cours d'emploi, mais aussi en vous connectant avec vos collègues dans tous les secteurs d'activité. Carrières chez Deloitte. Choisissez votre impact. Chez Deloitte, vos idées créent un impact et un changement significatif pour nos clients, nos gens et notre société. Votre expertise, votre expérience et votre perspective uniques nous aident à trouver de nouvelles façons de relever les défis les plus complexes afin que nous puissions améliorer l'avenir de nos travaux. Chez Deloitte, vous pouvez construire une carrière qui vous inspire et vous anime. Chez Deloitte, vous pouvez choisir votre impact. En Suisse, nous fournissons des services spécifiques à l'industrie dans les domaines de l'audit et de l'assurance, de la fiscalité et du droit, de la stratégie, du conseil sur les risques et les transactions et de la technologie et de la transformation. Avec près de 3 000 employés sur six sites, nous servons des entreprises et des organisations de toutes tailles dans tous les secteurs de l'industrie. Nous offrons un travail significatif et stimulant, un environnement inclusif et solidaire où vous pouvez être votre meilleur soi et où vous n'arrêterez jamais de grandir. Vous bénéficierez de conditions de travail flexibles et hybrides, de programmes de bien-être et de programmes parentaux ainsi que de nombreuses possibilités de connexion, de collaboration et d'apprentissage. Rejoignez-nous et devenez membre d'un réseau mondial de personnes partageant les mêmes idées et vouées à faire la différence, que ce soit en s'attaquant au changement climatique ou en améliorant 100 millions d'avenir d'ici 2030. Veuillez cliquer sur l'application maintenant pour soumettre une demande complète, y compris CV, lettre de motivation, références et certificats de diplôme. jobs.description:
Location : Zurich, Geneva Switzerland Work Pattern Percentage : 80-100% Help transform our clients’ organisations to support their business strategy Deloitte's Human Capital Consulting practice in Switzerland is at the forefront of transforming how organizations attract, develop, and retain their most valuable asset—their people. We partner with leading Swiss and international companies to reimagine their HR operating models, implement cutting-edge HR technology solutions, and build future-ready organizations. Our team combines deep HR expertise with advanced technology knowledge to deliver transformational outcomes across strategy, technology, and organizational change. We work across diverse industries and geographies, helping clients navigate the evolving world of work, embrace digital innovation, and unlock the full potential of their workforce. We are the largest Human Capital practice in the Swiss market and are widely recognized by our clients for our ability to walk in their shoes as a true partner, bring leading insight, expertise and consistently deliver high quality work. How you can make an impact As a Consultant in our HR Strategy & Technology practice, you will play a pivotal role in delivering high-impact HR transformation projects for our most important clients. You will:
• Drive HR Technology Implementations - Support the design, configuration, and deployment of leading HR platforms such as Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM Cloud, and other enterprise solutions
• Translate Business Needs into Solutions - Work closely with clients to understand their HR challenges and translate them into effective technology and process solutions
• Build Client Relationships - Develop strong partnerships with client stakeholders, earning their trust through expertise, professionalism, and genuine commitment to their success
• Collaborate with Expert Teams - Work alongside experienced consultants, functional experts, and technical specialists to deliver integrated solutions
• Develop Your Expertise - Grow your knowledge of HR technology, best practices, and industry trends while building a strong foundation for your consulting career
• Shape the Future of Work - Contribute to thought leadership and innovation in HR transformation, helping clients navigate the evolving workplace landscape Who are we looking for?
• Strong academic background, ideally a Master’s degree or MBA from a reputable institution, or equivalent professional experience.
• Understanding of HR processes, systems, and organizational dynamics
• Strong interest in and understanding of HR information systems, data management, and technology-enabled HR transformation
• First experience or exposure to HR technology platforms such as Workday, SAP SuccessFactors, Oracle HCM Cloud, or similar
• Genuine interest in understanding client needs and delivering value; ability to build rapport with stakeholders at all levels. Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage effectively with clients and internal teams.
• Positive, proactive attitude with a focus on delivering high-quality client service and contributing to team success.
• Fluency in written and spoken English and German is essential, proficiency in additional languages such as French is an advantage.
• Knowledge or experience in Artificial Intelligence (AI) applications in Human Capital or HR Technology is a plus
• Willingness to travel within Switzerland and internationally as required. Your team Become part of a diverse, multinational and highly motivated team. We will help you grow both personally and professionally: through our trainings, mentoring programmes and on-the-job learning, but also by connecting with your colleagues across all business lines. Life at Deloitte At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact. In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. Location: Zurich, Geneva Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100% Help Our Clients Successfully Manage Their Compensation and Payroll In today's complex global landscape, compliance is non-negotiable. Tax authorities worldwide are intensifying their focus on payroll accuracy and regulatory adherence—making expert guidance more critical than ever. This is where you come in. The Global Employer Services (GES) team, part of Deloitte's Tax & Legal practice, partners with multinational companies to navigate global mobility and payroll complexity with confidence. We deliver end-to-end payroll solutions and strategic advice that keeps our clients compliant, efficient, and ahead of the curve. How you can make an impact
• Master payroll fundamentals while solving real client challenges — work on complex issues like developing expense policies and navigating withholding tax assessments. You'll learn how payroll connects to broader business strategy.
• Build diverse, practical skills across the full payroll cycle — from monthly processing and wage type reviews to social security audits. Every project expands your technical toolkit and client-facing experience.
• Own critical processes end-to-end — record personnel and salary data, process direct payments via EBICS, distribute payslips, and ensure compliance. You'll see the direct impact of your work and develop a strong foundation in regulatory requirements.
• Develop relationships with key stakeholders — interact with local tax and social security authorities, prepare accurate monthly reports using ELM, and build credibility as a trusted payroll professional.
• Contribute meaningfully to your team — learn from one another, develop new skills and participate in the collective growth of you and your colleagues. Your input matters from day one, and you'll grow alongside experienced colleagues who mentor you. Who We Are Looking For
• You possess strong numerical skills and a keen understanding of complex interrelationships, demonstrating conscientiousness as well as a solution-oriented and team focused working style.
• You enjoy exploring new challenges and are eager to provide comprehensive payroll compliance and advisory services across all facets to multinational corporate clients.
• You hold a qualification in fiduciary services or a degree in Business Administration, Economics or a related discipline.
• You possess a high affinity for technology and are keen to learn and work with Artificial Intelligence, and payroll systems such as Abacus and SAP.
• You have excellent command of English and are fluent in either French or German; additional language skills are considered a significant advantage. Your Team Become part of a diverse, multinational and highly motivated team of 30+ across our Swiss offices. We will help you grow both personally and professionally: through our trainings, mentoring programmes and on-the-job learning, but also by connecting with your colleagues across all business lines. • Strategic growth area: Payroll is a key focus for our future expansion—you'll be part of an exciting journey as more multinational companies look for Swiss payroll support from us.
• Cooperative culture: A team-oriented environment that actively invests in your personal and professional development. Monthly processing of end-to-end payroll processes in national and international contexts.

jobs.description:
Location: Zurich Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100% Möchtest du im Bereich Consulting für Künstliche Intelligenz und Dat en Kundinnen und Kunden dabei unterstützen, strategische Entscheidungen zu treffen? Unser Team begleitet die Umsetzung umfangreicher Datenprogramme. Werde Teil unseres Teams und gestalte mit uns die Zukunft. Wir unterstützen unsere Kunden beim Aufbau modernster Datenlandschaften, um ihre Analysefähigkeit auf das nächste Level zu bringen. Du analysierst und verstehst kundenspezifische Lösungen von der Datenintegration, Datentransformation bis hin zu Analytics - mit dem Ziel das Datenmanagement unter Einsatz von State- of - the -Art Technologien nachhaltig zu verbessern. Für diese Position bieten wir derzeit Starttermine ab September 202 6 an. Dein Impact
• Entwurf und Implementierung moderner Datenlösungen im Bereich Datenmanagement (z. B. Datenqualität, Stamm- und Referenzdaten, Datenkataloge und Datenplattformen), um qualitativ hochwertige und verwertbare Daten bereitzustellen.
• Entwicklung von Datenstrategien, die unseren Kunden dabei helfen, ihre Geschäftsziele in den Bereichen Compliance, Kostensenkung und Umsatzsteigerung zu erreichen.
• Konzeption komplexer Daten- und Analytik-Transformationen durch die Bereitstellung architektonischer, technischer und organisatorischer Grundlagen sowie Beratung der Kunden bei der Durchführung dieser Transformationen, die erhebliche Auswirkungen auf die Organisation haben .
• Aufbau und Pflege enger Kundenbeziehungen im Rahmen von Projektarbeit oder Business Development sowie Erweiterung des internen und externen Netzwerks.
• Vorbildfunktion durch hohe Arbeitsmoral, ausgeprägte Führungsqualitäten und fachliche Kompetenz.
• Weiterentwicklung deiner Kompetenzen in verschiedenen Branchen und Fachgebieten sowie Weitergabe deines Wissens an Kolleginnen und Kollegen. Wen wir suchen Antrieb und Motivation
• Leidenschaftliche Persönlichkeiten, die eine Karriere in der Beratung mit Schwerpunkt Data Engineering aufbauen möchten .
• Ausgeprägte Lernbereitschaft, Offenheit für neue Themen und die Fähigkeit, mehrere Aufgaben selbstständig in einem dynamischen Umfeld zu steuern . Beratungs- und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten
• Starke Schreib- und Microsoft PowerPoint-Fähigkeiten: Fähigkeit, aussagekräftige Präsentationen zu gestalten .
• Starke konzeptionelle Fähigkeiten: Fähigkeit, unterschiedliche Anforderungen zu einem stimmigen Lösungsdesign zusammenzuführen und komplexe Probleme zu vereinfachen .
• Business-IT-Übersetzer: Fähigkeit, als Brücke zwischen Geschäftsanforderungen und technischen Lösungen zu fungieren .
• Liebe zum Detail und Fähigkeit, technische Spezifikationen klar in schriftlicher und mündlicher Form zu kommunizieren . Technische Expertise
• Praktische Erfahrung mit Datenmanagement, Datenplattformen oder Data Engineering-Lösungen ist dringend empfohlen .
• Fundierte Kenntnisse in SQL und Python sind erforderlich .
• Erfahrung mit Cloud-Plattformen wie AWS, Azure oder GCP, einschließlich der Arbeit mit Data Warehouses , ETL-Tools und modernen Data Stack-Technologien ist erforderlich .
• Kenntnisse von Datenplattform-Tools (z.B. Snowflake, Databricks , Apache Spark, Airflow ) und Datenvisualisierungstools (z.B. PowerBI , Tableau) sind erforderlich .
• Praktische Erfahrung mit ETL/ELT-Pipelines und Data Orchestration (z.B. Apache Airflow , Prefect , dbt ) ist erforderlich .
• Verständnis von Data Warehouse- und Data Lake-Architekturen sowie deren Unterschiede und Anwendungsfälle .

A Deloitte, puoi costruire una carriera che ti ispira e ti stimola. A Deloitte, puoi scegliere il tuo impatto. Offriamo lavoro significativo e stimolante, un ambiente inclusivo e di supporto in cui si può essere il vostro migliore sé e dove non smetterete mai di crescere. Potrai beneficiare di condizioni di lavoro flessibili e ibridi, il benessere e i programmi genitoriali, così come molte opportunità per collegare, collaborare e imparare. Unisciti a noi e entra a far parte di una rete globale di persone affini dedicate a fare la differenza, sia affrontando il cambiamento climatico o migliorando 100 milioni di futures entro il 2030. jobs.description:
Location: Zurich Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100% Help our clients to align strategic business goals with AI innovation to unlock transformative value Deloitte AI & Data empowers clients to harness AI and data not only as technological assets but as strategic enablers that drive business growth and competitive advantage. We bridge the gap between overarching business objectives and complex technical capabilities, ensuring AI initiatives deliver measurable impact aligned with corporate strategy. This role is ideal for professionals who combine strong business acumen with a solid understanding of AI technologies, capable of supporting the development of AI strategies and translating business goals into actionable AI operating models and use case enablement roadmaps. How you can make an impact:
• Collaborate with clients to define AI strategies that align with their business vision, market positioning, and operational priorities.
• Translate strategic business goals into clear AI use cases, requirements, and implementation roadmaps.
• Contribute to thought leadership on AI adoption, governance, ethical considerations, and risk management in line with organisational objectives.
• Support cross-functional collaboration between business stakeholders and technical teams to ensure alignment and successful delivery.
• Assist in business development by identifying strategic AI opportunities and supporting the development of compelling proposals.
• Build client relationships through quality project delivery, advisory and delivery excellence. Who we are looking for Drive and Motivation:
• Passionate about the intersection of AI, business strategy, and innovation.
• Eager to build expertise in AI strategy consulting and influence business transformation.
• Self-motivated and able to manage multiple priorities in a dynamic environment with guidance from senior colleagues. Consulting and Communication Skills:
• Ability to articulate complex AI concepts in business terms, both verbally and in writing.
• Proficient in creating clear presentations and strategic documents (Microsoft PowerPoint proficiency essential).
• Ability to support stakeholder engagement and contribute to workshops that align diverse perspectives.
• Good conceptual capability with the ability to consolidate diverse inputs into coherent strategies. Technical and Strategic Expertise:
• Good understanding of AI technologies, data analytics, and digital transformation trends.
• Familiarity with AI use cases, data platforms, and emerging technologies such as Large Language Models (LLMs) is a plus.
• Understanding of AI risks, ethical considerations, and regulatory impacts from a strategic viewpoint.
• Background in business analysis or technology is desirable; management consulting experience is a plus. Language Proficiency:
• Fluent in English; proficiency in German and/or French is highly preferred to engage effectively with local clients and teams. Industry Experience:
• First relevant experience in consulting, technology, or industry roles with exposure to AI-driven business initiatives.
• Experience in Banking, Insurance, Life Sciences, Healthcare, or other regulated industries is advantageous. Your team Become part of a diverse and multinational team of 60+ highly motivated individuals located in our Zurich or Geneva offices. We specialise in AI & data – how to structure it, how to source it, how to transform it, how to store it, and how to consume it. Join our fast-paced and fun team, working alongside highly talented colleagues on varied and exciting projects, with access to excellent and continuous learning opportunities. Deloitte AI & Data is the leading data & analytics consulting team in Switzerland. You will have a chance to work with outstanding colleagues and have access to variety of clients, vendors, and technologies. Our business is growing fast and there are plenty market opportunities to develop career in the direction that you want. We will help you grow both personally and professionally: through our trainings, mentoring programmes, and on-the-job learning, but also by working with clients and vendors across different industries. Life at Deloitte At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact. In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors. We offer meaningful and challenging work, an inclusive and supportive environment where you can be your best self and where you will never stop growing. You will benefit from flexible and hybrid working conditions, wellbeing and parental programmes as well as many opportunities to connect, collaborate and learn. Join us and become part of a global network of like-minded people dedicated to making a difference, whether by addressing climate change or improving 100 million futures by 2030. Want to know more about opportunities at Deloitte? Visit www.apply.deloitte.ch . How to apply We look forward to hearing from you! Please click on “apply now” to submit a complete application, including CV, cover letter, references and degree certificates. If you have any questions, please contact Aarabi at talent@deloitte.ch *We consider all qualified applicants for employment regardless of race, ethnicity, religious beliefs, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability, in accordance with applicable law. Research shows that women are less likely to apply for roles unless they match all the criteria; do not hold yourself back – apply today. We do not accept applications from recruitment agencies for this position. descriptionByLocale.it:
Offriamo con orgoglio:
• Un posto di lavoro sicuro con zero tolleranza per molestie.
• Ambienti aperti dove le persone sono libere di essere se stesse.
• Una comunità inclusiva che crede nel rispetto e nel merito. Posizione: Zurich Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100% Aiuta i nostri clienti ad allineare gli obiettivi strategici di business con l'innovazione AI per sbloccare il valore trasformativo Deloitte AI & Data consente ai clienti di sfruttare l'IA e i dati non solo come asset tecnologici ma come abilitatori strategici che guidano la crescita aziendale e il vantaggio competitivo. Colpiamo il divario tra obiettivi aziendali e capacità tecniche complesse, garantendo alle iniziative AI un impatto misurabile allineato alla strategia aziendale. Questo ruolo è ideale per i professionisti che combinano forte acume aziendale con una solida comprensione delle tecnologie AI, in grado di sostenere lo sviluppo delle strategie AI e tradurre gli obiettivi aziendali in modelli operativi AI attuabili e utilizzare case abilitament roadmap. Come si può fare un impatto:
• Collabora con i clienti per definire le strategie AI che si allineano alla loro visione aziendale, al posizionamento del mercato e alle priorità operative.
• Tradurre obiettivi strategici di business in casi di uso AI chiaro, requisiti e roadmap di attuazione.
• Contribuire alla leadership di pensiero sull'adozione, la governance, le considerazioni etiche e la gestione dei rischi in linea con gli obiettivi organizzativi.
• Supporta la collaborazione tra gli stakeholder aziendali e i team tecnici per garantire l'allineamento e la consegna di successo.
• Assistere nello sviluppo aziendale individuando opportunità strategiche di AI e sostenere lo sviluppo di proposte convincenti.
• Costruisci i rapporti con i clienti attraverso la fornitura di progetti di qualità, consulenza e eccellenza di consegna. Chi stiamo cercando Drive e Motivazione:
• Appassionato all'intersezione dell'IA, della strategia aziendale e dell'innovazione.
• Impaziente di costruire competenze nella consulenza di strategia AI e di influenzare la trasformazione aziendale.
• Automotivata e in grado di gestire più priorità in un ambiente dinamico con la guida di colleghi senior. Competenze di consulenza e comunicazione:
• Capacità di articolare concetti AI complessi in termini di business, sia verbalmente che per iscritto.
• Proficiente nella creazione di presentazioni chiare e documenti strategici (Microsoft PowerPoint competenza essenziale).
• Capacità di sostenere l'impegno degli stakeholder e contribuire a workshop che allineano prospettive diverse.
• Buona capacità concettuale con la capacità di consolidare diversi input in strategie coerenti. Competenza tecnica e strategica:
• Buona comprensione delle tecnologie AI, analisi dei dati e tendenze di trasformazione digitale.
• La familiarità con casi di uso AI, piattaforme di dati e tecnologie emergenti come i modelli di lingua grande (LLMs) è un plus.
• Comprensione dei rischi AI, considerazioni etiche e impatti normativi da un punto di vista strategico.
• Lo sfondo nell'analisi aziendale o la tecnologia è auspicabile; l'esperienza di consulenza di gestione è un plus. Proficienza linguistica:
• Fluente in inglese; la competenza in tedesco e/o francese è altamente preferita per impegnarsi efficacemente con i clienti e le squadre locali. Esperienza del settore:
• Prima esperienza rilevante nei ruoli di consulenza, tecnologia o industria con l'esposizione a iniziative aziendali basate su AI.
• L'esperienza in banche, assicurazioni, scienze della vita, sanità, o altre industrie regolamentate è vantaggiosa. Il vostro team fa parte di un team diversificato e multinazionale di 60+ individui altamente motivati situati nei nostri uffici di Zurigo o Ginevra. Siamo specializzati in dati AI & – come strutturarlo, come fonte, come trasformarlo, come memorizzarlo e come consumarlo. Unisciti al nostro team veloce e divertente, lavorando insieme a colleghi di grande talento su progetti diversi ed emozionanti, con l'accesso a eccellenti e continue opportunità di apprendimento. Deloitte AI & Data è il principale team di consulenza dati e analisi in Svizzera. Avrete la possibilità di lavorare con colleghi eccezionali e avere accesso a varietà di clienti, fornitori e tecnologie. Il nostro business sta crescendo velocemente e ci sono molte opportunità di mercato per sviluppare la carriera nella direzione che si desidera. Vi aiuteremo a crescere sia personalmente che professionalmente: attraverso i nostri corsi di formazione, programmi di mentoring, e l'apprendimento on-the-job, ma anche lavorando con clienti e fornitori in diversi settori. Vita a Deloitte A Deloitte, le tue idee creano impatto e innescano cambiamenti significativi per i nostri clienti, persone e società. La vostra esperienza, background e prospettiva unica ci aiuta a trovare nuovi modi nelle sfide più complesse in modo da poter illuminare i futuri di quelli che il nostro lavoro colpisce. A Deloitte, puoi costruire una carriera che ti ispira e ti stimola. A Deloitte, puoi scegliere il tuo impatto. In Svizzera, forniamo servizi specifici per il settore nei settori Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. Con quasi 3.000 dipendenti in sei sedi, serviamo aziende e organizzazioni di tutte le dimensioni in tutti i settori industriali. Offriamo lavoro significativo e stimolante, un ambiente inclusivo e di supporto in cui si può essere il vostro migliore sé e dove non smetterete mai di crescere. Potrai beneficiare di condizioni di lavoro flessibili e ibridi, il benessere e i programmi genitoriali, così come molte opportunità per collegare, collaborare e imparare. Unisciti a noi e entra a far parte di una rete globale di persone affini dedicate a fare la differenza, sia affrontando il cambiamento climatico o migliorando 100 milioni di futures entro il 2030. Vuoi saperne di più sulle opportunità a Deloitte? Visita www.apply.deloitte.ch . Non vediamo l'ora di sentire da voi! Si prega di fare clic su “applica ora” per inviare una domanda completa, tra cui CV, lettera di copertura, riferimenti e certificati di laurea. Se hai domande, contatta Aarabi all'indirizzo talent@deloitte.ch * Consideriamo tutti i candidati qualificati per l'occupazione indipendentemente da razza, etnia, credenze religiose, sesso, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, origine nazionale, età o disabilità, in conformità con la legge applicabile. La ricerca mostra che le donne sono meno propensi a candidarsi per i ruoli a meno che non corrispondano a tutti i criteri; non si trattengano indietro – si applicano oggi. Non accettiamo domande da agenzie di reclutamento per questa posizione. Deloitte Consulting AG e Deloitte AG sono affiliati a Deloitte NSE LLP, società membro di Deloitte Touche Tohmatsu Limited, società privata britannica limitata dalla garanzia (“DTTL”) AI Strategy

Wir bieten stolz:
• Ein sicherer Arbeitsplatz mit null Toleranz für Belästigung.
• Offene Umgebungen, in denen Menschen frei sind, sie selbst zu sein.
• Eine inklusive Gemeinschaft, die an Respekt und Verdienst glaubt. Standort: Zurich Work Pattern Prozentsatz: 80-100% Helfen Sie unseren Kunden, strategische Geschäftsziele mit KI-Innovationen in Einklang zu bringen, um transformativen Wert zu erschließen Deloitte AI & Data befähigt Kunden, KI und Daten nicht nur als technologische Assets, sondern auch als strategische Enabler zu nutzen, die das Geschäftswachstum und den Wettbewerbsvorteil vorantreiben. Wir schließen die Lücke zwischen übergreifenden Geschäftszielen und komplexen technischen Fähigkeiten und stellen sicher, dass KI-Initiativen messbare Auswirkungen im Einklang mit der Unternehmensstrategie erzielen. Diese Rolle ist ideal für Profis, die starken Geschäftssinn mit einem soliden Verständnis von KI-Technologien kombinieren, in der Lage sind, die Entwicklung von KI-Strategien zu unterstützen und Geschäftsziele in umsetzbare KI-Betriebsmodelle und Anwendungsfall-Fahrpläne zu übersetzen. Wie Sie eine Wirkung erzielen können:
• Arbeiten Sie mit Kunden zusammen, um KI-Strategien zu definieren, die mit ihrer Geschäftsvision, Marktpositionierung und operativen Prioritäten übereinstimmen.
• Übersetzen Sie strategische Geschäftsziele in klare KI-Anwendungsfälle, Anforderungen und Umsetzungs-Roadmaps.
• Beitrag zur Vordenkerrolle in Bezug auf KI-Adoption, Governance, ethische Überlegungen und Risikomanagement im Einklang mit den organisatorischen Zielen.
• Unterstützung der funktionsübergreifenden Zusammenarbeit zwischen Geschäftsbeteiligten und technischen Teams, um die Ausrichtung und erfolgreiche Umsetzung sicherzustellen.
• Unterstützen Sie die Geschäftsentwicklung, indem Sie strategische KI-Möglichkeiten identifizieren und die Entwicklung überzeugender Vorschläge unterstützen.
• Aufbau von Kundenbeziehungen durch qualitativ hochwertige Projektabwicklung, Beratung und Lieferqualität. Wen wir für Antrieb und Motivation suchen:
• Leidenschaft für die Schnittstelle von KI, Geschäftsstrategie und Innovation.
• Begierig darauf, Fachwissen in der KI-Strategieberatung aufzubauen und die Geschäftstransformation zu beeinflussen.
• Selbstmotiviert und in der Lage, mehrere Prioritäten in einem dynamischen Umfeld mit Anleitung von älteren Kollegen zu verwalten. Beratung und Kommunikationsfähigkeiten:
• Fähigkeit, komplexe KI-Konzepte geschäftlich sowohl mündlich als auch schriftlich zu artikulieren.
• Proficient in der Erstellung von klaren Präsentationen und strategischen Dokumenten (Microsoft PowerPoint Kenntnisse unerlässlich).
• Fähigkeit, das Engagement von Stakeholdern zu unterstützen und zu Workshops beizutragen, die verschiedene Perspektiven miteinander in Einklang bringen.
• Gute konzeptionelle Fähigkeit mit der Fähigkeit, verschiedene Inputs in kohärente Strategien zu konsolidieren. Technische und strategische Expertise:
• Gutes Verständnis von KI-Technologien, Datenanalysen und digitalen Transformationstrends.
• Die Vertrautheit mit KI-Anwendungsfällen, Datenplattformen und neuen Technologien wie Large Language Models (LLMs) ist ein Plus.
• Verständnis von KI-Risiken, ethischen Überlegungen und regulatorischen Auswirkungen aus strategischer Sicht.
• Hintergrund in Business-Analyse oder Technologie ist wünschenswert; Management-Beratung Erfahrung ist ein Plus. Sprachkenntnisse:
• Fließend Englisch; Kenntnisse in Deutsch und / oder Französisch sind sehr bevorzugt, um effektiv mit lokalen Kunden und Teams zu interagieren. Branchenerfahrung:
• Erste relevante Erfahrung in der Beratung, Technologie oder Industrie Rollen mit Exposition gegenüber AI-getriebenen Business-Initiativen.
• Erfahrung in Banken, Versicherungen, Life Sciences, Healthcare oder anderen regulierten Branchen ist von Vorteil. Werden Sie Teil eines vielfältigen und multinationalen Teams von über 60 hochmotivierten Mitarbeitern in unseren Büros in Zürich oder Genf. Wir sind spezialisiert auf KI & Daten – wie man sie strukturiert, wie man sie bezieht, wie man sie transformiert, wie man sie speichert und wie man sie konsumiert. Treten Sie unserem schnellen und unterhaltsamen Team bei und arbeiten Sie mit hochtalentierten Kollegen an abwechslungsreichen und aufregenden Projekten mit Zugang zu hervorragenden und kontinuierlichen Lernmöglichkeiten. Sie haben die Möglichkeit, mit hervorragenden Kollegen zusammenzuarbeiten und haben Zugang zu einer Vielzahl von Kunden, Anbietern und Technologien. Unser Geschäft wächst schnell und es gibt viele Marktchancen, um Karriere in die Richtung zu entwickeln, die Sie wollen. Wir helfen Ihnen, sowohl persönlich als auch professionell zu wachsen: durch unsere Schulungen, Mentoring-Programme und On-the-Job-Lernen, aber auch durch die Zusammenarbeit mit Kunden und Anbietern in verschiedenen Branchen. Bei Deloitte erzeugen Ihre Ideen Wirkung und bewirken bedeutende Veränderungen für unsere Kunden, Menschen und die Gesellschaft. Ihre einzigartige Expertise, Ihr Hintergrund und Ihre Perspektive helfen uns, neue Wege in die komplexesten Herausforderungen zu finden, damit wir die Zukunft derer, die unsere Arbeit beeinflusst, erhellen können. Nous offrons fièrement :
• Un lieu de travail sûr et une tolérance zéro pour le harcèlement.
• Des environnements ouverts où les gens sont libres d'être eux-mêmes.
• Une communauté inclusive qui croit au respect et au mérite. Lieu: Zurich Profil de travail Pourcentage: 80-100% Aidez nos clients à aligner les objectifs stratégiques d'affaires avec l'innovation AI pour débloquer la valeur transformative Deloitte AI & Data permet aux clients d'exploiter l'IA et les données non seulement en tant qu'actifs technologiques, mais en tant que moteurs stratégiques qui stimulent la croissance d'entreprise et l'avantage concurrentiel. Nous comblons l'écart entre les objectifs opérationnels globaux et les capacités techniques complexes, en veillant à ce que les initiatives d'IA produisent un impact mesurable aligné sur la stratégie ministérielle. Ce rôle est idéal pour les professionnels qui combinent un fort sens des affaires avec une solide compréhension des technologies de l'IA, capables de soutenir le développement de stratégies de l'IA et de traduire les objectifs commerciaux en modèles opérationnels de l'IA actionnables et d'utiliser des feuilles de route d'activation de cas. Comment faire un impact :
• Collaborer avec les clients pour définir des stratégies d'IA qui cadrent avec leur vision d'entreprise, leur positionnement sur le marché et leurs priorités opérationnelles.
• Traduire les objectifs stratégiques des entreprises en cas d'utilisation claire de l'IA, en exigences et en feuilles de route de mise en oeuvre.
• Contribuer à la réflexion sur l'adoption de l'IA, la gouvernance, les considérations éthiques et la gestion des risques conformément aux objectifs organisationnels.
• Soutenir la collaboration interfonctionnelle entre les intervenants commerciaux et les équipes techniques pour assurer l'alignement et la prestation réussie.
• Aider au développement des entreprises en identifiant les possibilités stratégiques d'IA et en appuyant l'élaboration de propositions convaincantes.
• Établir des relations avec les clients grâce à l'exécution de projets de qualité, à des conseils et à l'excellence de la prestation. Qui nous cherchons Drive and Motivation:
• Passionné par l'intersection de l'IA, de la stratégie commerciale et de l'innovation.
• Désirez acquérir une expertise en conseil en stratégie d'IA et influencer la transformation des affaires.
• Automotivé et capable de gérer de multiples priorités dans un environnement dynamique avec l'orientation de collègues supérieurs. Compétences en conseil et en communication :
• Capacité d'articuler des concepts complexes d'IA en termes d'affaires, tant verbalement que par écrit.
• Capacité à créer des présentations claires et des documents stratégiques (Microsoft PowerPoint compétence essentielle).
• Capacité d'appuyer la participation des intervenants et de contribuer à des ateliers qui harmonisent diverses perspectives.
• Bonne capacité conceptuelle avec la capacité de consolider divers apports dans des stratégies cohérentes. Expertise technique et stratégique :
• Bonne compréhension des technologies d'IA, de l'analyse des données et des tendances de transformation numérique.
• La connaissance des cas d'utilisation de l'IA, des plates-formes de données et des technologies émergentes comme les modèles de grande langue (LLM) est un atout.
• Compréhension des risques liés à l'IA, des considérations éthiques et des répercussions réglementaires d'un point de vue stratégique.
• Le contexte de l'analyse des affaires ou de la technologie est souhaitable; l'expérience de conseil en gestion est un atout. Compétence linguistique :
• La maîtrise de l'anglais; la maîtrise de l'allemand et/ou du français est hautement préférée pour s'engager efficacement auprès des clients et des équipes locales. Expérience de l'industrie :
• Première expérience pertinente dans le domaine de la consultation, de la technologie ou des rôles de l'industrie en ce qui concerne l'exposition aux initiatives d'affaires axées sur l'IA.
• L'expérience en banque, en assurance, en sciences de la vie, en santé ou dans d'autres secteurs réglementés est avantageuse. Joignez-vous à notre équipe qui s'amuse et qui travaille avec des collègues très talentueux sur des projets variés et passionnants, avec accès à d'excellentes possibilités d'apprentissage continu. Deloitte AI & Data est la principale équipe de conseil en matière de données et d'analyse en Suisse. Vous aurez la chance de travailler avec des collègues exceptionnels et d'avoir accès à divers clients, fournisseurs et technologies. Notre entreprise est en croissance rapide et il ya de nombreuses opportunités de marché pour développer une carrière dans la direction que vous voulez. Nous vous aiderons à grandir personnellement et professionnellement : grâce à nos formations, à nos programmes de mentorat et à l'apprentissage en cours d'emploi, mais aussi en travaillant avec des clients et des fournisseurs de différentes industries. jobs.description:
Location : Zurich, Geneva Work Pattern Percentage : 80-100% Help our clients navigate the future with confidence and embrace decision making with clear data-driven choices Deloitte AI & Data helps clients unlock the power of AI and data to deliver better human-centric solutions that catalyze growth and efficiencies. We enable them to leverage data, analytics, modern platforms, and data science & AI technologies to uncover hidden relationships from vast troves of data, generate insights, and inform their decision-making. We help clients transform their business by designing and implementing data solutions to excel in their markets. Our role is to understand their business problems and use data-driven thinking and technology to achieve outcomes that drive their business forward. This role is open to candidates with either an AI/Analytics or a Data Engineering/Data Platform background and preference. During the interview process, we will determine the best fit for you within one of these specialized subteams. We also welcome applications from trainee candidates with limited work experience, provided they are available for full-time work (not returning to school). After 4–6 months in a trainee role, we will reassess readiness for a Business Analyst role. For this role, we are currently offering start dates from February 2026. How you can make an impact
• Design and implement AI and data strategies and modern solutions – including data management, platforms and AI use cases – that enable clients to achieve their business objectives across regulatory, cost and revenue pillars.
• Provide architectural, technical and organizational thought leadership to guide complex data and AI transformations with significant organizational implications.
• Drive Data & AI use cases from business value concept to production.
• Build and maintain trusted client relationships through project delivery and business development, expanding your network internally and externally.
• Support business development opportunities to generate new projects.
• Be a role model for people you work with by demonstrating strong work ethic, leadership, and subject matter competence.
• Continuously grow your knowledge across industries and share insights with Deloitte talent. Who we are looking for Drive and Motivation:
• Passionate individuals eager to build a career in AI & Data Consulting.
• Strong drive to learn, master new topics and manage multiple activities independently in a fast-paced environment. Consulting and Communication Skills:
• Strong writing and Microsoft Power Point skills: Ability to design and shape meaningful presentations.
• Strong Conceptual Capability: Ability to consolidate diverse requirements into coherent solution designs, simplifying complex problems.
• Business-IT Translator: Ability to act as the bridge between business needs and technical solutions.
• Attention to detail and ability to communicate technical specifics clearly in both written and oral forms. Technical expertise:
• First practical experience with AI & analytics solutions is highly recommended.
• Familiarity with SQL and Python is a plus.
• Experience with cloud platforms such as AWS, Azure or GCP, including working with Large Language Models (LLMs) and related services is a plus.
• Knowledge of data platforms tools (e.g., Snowflake, Databricks, Dataiku) and data visualisation tools (e.g., PowerBI, Tableau) is a plus.
• Strong engineering or mathematics background is advantageous. Language Proficiency:
• Fluent in English; fluency in German and/or French is highly preferred to facilitate communication with diverse teams and stakeholders. Industry Experience:
• First relevant experience in consulting, tech companies, or industry-specific roles, particularly in AI & data-driven fields.
• Previous experience in the Banking, Insurance, Life Science or Healthcare sector is advantageous. Your team Become part of a diverse and multinational team of 50+ highly motivated individuals located in our Zurich or Geneva offices. We specialise in AI & data – how to structure it, how to source it, how to transform it, how to store it, and how to consume it. Join our fast-paced and fun team, working alongside highly talented colleagues on varied and exciting projects, with access to excellent and continuous learning opportunities. Deloitte AI & Data is the leading data & analytics consulting team in Switzerland. You will have a chance to work with outstanding colleagues and have access to variety of clients, vendors, and technologies. Our business is growing fast and there are plenty market opportunities to develop career in the direction that you want. We will help you grow both personally and professionally: through our trainings, mentoring programmes, and on-the-job learning, but also by working with clients and vendors across different industries. Life at Deloitte At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact. In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors. We offer meaningful and challenging work, an inclusive and supportive environment where you can be your best self and where you will never stop growing. You will benefit from flexible and hybrid working conditions, wellbeing and parental programmes as well as many opportunities to connect, collaborate and learn. Join us and become part of a global network of like-minded people dedicated to making a difference, whether by addressing climate change or improving 100 million futures by 2030. Want to know more about opportunities at Deloitte? Visit www.apply.deloitte.ch . How to apply We look forward to hearing from you! Please click on “apply now” to submit a complete application, including CV, cover letter, references and degree certificates. If you have any questions, please contact Aarabi at talent@deloitte.ch *We consider all qualified applicants for employment regardless of race, ethnicity, religious beliefs, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability, in accordance with applicable law. Research shows that women are less likely to apply for roles unless they match all the criteria; don’t hold yourself back – apply today. © 2026. For information, contact Deloitte AG. All rights reserved. Deloitte AG is an equal opportunities employer. Requisition reference: 23940 AI & Insights

Posizione: Zurigo, Geneva Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100% Aiuta i nostri clienti a navigare nel futuro con fiducia e ad abbracciare il processo decisionale con chiare scelte basate sui dati Deloitte AI & Data aiuta i clienti a sbloccare il potere dell'IA e i dati per fornire soluzioni umane-centriche migliori che catalizzano la crescita e l'efficienza. Gli consentiamo di sfruttare i dati, le analisi, le piattaforme moderne e le tecnologie dell'informatica e dell'intelligenza artificiale per scoprire le relazioni nascoste da vasti dati, generare intuizioni e informare il loro processo decisionale. Aiutiamo i clienti a trasformare il loro business progettando e implementando soluzioni di dati per eccellere nei loro mercati. Il nostro ruolo è quello di capire i loro problemi di business e utilizzare il pensiero e la tecnologia data-driven per raggiungere i risultati che portano avanti il loro business. Questo ruolo è aperto ai candidati con un AI/Analitica o uno sfondo e preferenza di Data Engineering/Data Platform. Durante il processo di intervista, determineremo la soluzione migliore per voi all'interno di uno di questi sottoteam specializzati. Accogliamo anche le domande dei candidati tirocinanti con esperienza lavorativa limitata, a condizione che siano disponibili per il lavoro a tempo pieno (non di ritorno a scuola). Dopo 4-6 mesi in un ruolo di tirocinante, ribadiamo la disponibilità per un ruolo di Business Analyst. Per questo ruolo, stiamo offrendo le date di inizio dal febbraio 2026. Come si può fare un impatto
• Progettazione e realizzazione di strategie AI e dati e soluzioni moderne – tra cui gestione dei dati, piattaforme e casi di utilizzo AI – che consentono ai clienti di raggiungere i propri obiettivi aziendali attraverso pilastri di regolazione, costi e ricavi.
• Fornire leadership di pensiero architettonica, tecnica e organizzativa per guidare i dati complessi e le trasformazioni AI con significative implicazioni organizzative.
• Drive Data & AI utilizza casi dal concetto di valore aziendale alla produzione.
• Costruisci e mantieni relazioni con i clienti affidabili attraverso la consegna del progetto e lo sviluppo aziendale, espandendo la tua rete internamente ed esternamente.
• Supporto opportunità di sviluppo aziendale per generare nuovi progetti.
• Sii un modello di ruolo per le persone con cui lavori dimostrando una forte etica del lavoro, leadership e competenza di materia.
• Crescere costantemente le vostre conoscenze in settori e condividere intuizioni con il talento Deloitte. Chi stiamo cercando Drive e Motivazione:
• Persone passionali desiderose di costruire una carriera in AI & Data Consulting.
• Forte sforzo per imparare, padroneggiare nuovi argomenti e gestire più attività in modo indipendente in un ambiente frenetico. Competenze di consulenza e comunicazione:
• Forte scrittura e Microsoft Power Point competenze: Capacità di progettare e modellare presentazioni significative.
• Forte capacità concettuale: capacità di consolidare diversi requisiti in progetti di soluzioni coerenti, semplificando i problemi complessi.
• Traduttore Business-IT: Capacità di agire come ponte tra le esigenze aziendali e le soluzioni tecniche.
• Attenzione ai dettagli e alla capacità di comunicare con chiarezza le specifiche tecniche sia in forma scritta che orale. Competenza tecnica:
• La prima esperienza pratica con soluzioni AI & analytics è altamente raccomandata.
• La familiarità con SQL e Python è un vantaggio.
• Esperienza con piattaforme cloud come AWS, Azure o GCP, tra cui lavorare con modelli di lingua grande (LLMs) e servizi correlati è un plus.
• La conoscenza degli strumenti delle piattaforme di dati (ad esempio, Snowflake, Databricks, Dataiku) e degli strumenti di visualizzazione dei dati (ad esempio, PowerBI, Tableau) è un plus.
• Forte background di ingegneria o matematica è vantaggioso. Proficienza linguistica:
• Fluente in inglese; la fluenza in tedesco e/o francese è molto preferita per facilitare la comunicazione con diversi team e stakeholder. Esperienza del settore:
• Prima esperienza rilevante in consulenza, aziende tecnologiche o ruoli specifici del settore, in particolare nei settori AI & data-driven.
• L'esperienza precedente nel settore bancario, assicurativo, scienze della vita o sanità è vantaggiosa. Il vostro team fa parte di un team diversificato e multinazionale di 50+ individui altamente motivati situati nei nostri uffici di Zurigo o Ginevra. Siamo specializzati in dati AI & – come strutturarlo, come fonte, come trasformarlo, come memorizzarlo e come consumarlo. Unisciti al nostro team veloce e divertente, lavorando insieme a colleghi di grande talento su progetti diversi ed emozionanti, con l'accesso a eccellenti e continue opportunità di apprendimento. Deloitte AI & Data è il principale team di consulenza dati e analisi in Svizzera. Avrete la possibilità di lavorare con colleghi eccezionali e avere accesso a varietà di clienti, fornitori e tecnologie. Il nostro business sta crescendo velocemente e ci sono molte opportunità di mercato per sviluppare la carriera nella direzione che si desidera. Vi aiuteremo a crescere sia personalmente che professionalmente: attraverso i nostri corsi di formazione, programmi di mentoring, e l'apprendimento on-the-job, ma anche lavorando con clienti e fornitori in diversi settori. Vita a Deloitte A Deloitte, le tue idee creano impatto e innescano cambiamenti significativi per i nostri clienti, persone e società. La vostra esperienza, background e prospettiva unica ci aiuta a trovare nuovi modi nelle sfide più complesse in modo da poter illuminare i futuri di quelli che il nostro lavoro colpisce. A Deloitte, puoi costruire una carriera che ti ispira e ti stimola. A Deloitte, puoi scegliere il tuo impatto. In Svizzera, forniamo servizi specifici per il settore nei settori Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. Con quasi 3.000 dipendenti in sei sedi, serviamo aziende e organizzazioni di tutte le dimensioni in tutti i settori industriali. Offriamo lavoro significativo e stimolante, un ambiente inclusivo e di supporto in cui si può essere il vostro migliore sé e dove non smetterete mai di crescere. Potrai beneficiare di condizioni di lavoro flessibili e ibridi, il benessere e i programmi genitoriali, così come molte opportunità per collegare, collaborare e imparare. Unisciti a noi e entra a far parte di una rete globale di persone affini dedicate a fare la differenza, sia affrontando il cambiamento climatico o migliorando 100 milioni di futures entro il 2030. Vuoi saperne di più sulle opportunità a Deloitte? Visita www.apply.deloitte.ch . Non vediamo l'ora di sentire da voi! Si prega di fare clic su “applica ora” per inviare una domanda completa, tra cui CV, lettera di copertura, riferimenti e certificati di laurea. Se hai domande, contatta Aarabi all'indirizzo talent@deloitte.ch * Consideriamo tutti i candidati qualificati per l'occupazione indipendentemente da razza, etnia, credenze religiose, sesso, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, origine nazionale, età o disabilità, in conformità con la legge applicabile. La ricerca mostra che le donne sono meno propensi a candidarsi per i ruoli a meno che non corrispondano a tutti i criteri; non trattenetevi indietro – si applicano oggi. © 2026. With Controls Assurance, we deliver services that provide confidence in an organisation's internal control and ensure a framework that meets financial, operational, and legal requirements. Your day-to-day tasks may include leading projects and teams in financial internal controls work and advising clients on issue solving and improvement in the different business areas. • As a controls Assistant / Senior focusing on Controls, you will interact with clients directly and you will also collaborate with a diverse group of talented professionals across the firm. You will use our cutting-edge tools and technologies. Responsibilities will include:
• Advise on Internal Controls: Support teams and clients in identifying risks, designing controls, optimizing internal control frameworks, operate mitigation efforts and controls effectively.
• Client & Auditor Collaboration: Interface with external auditors to facilitate compliance assessments and support process and controls owners in addressing control deficiencies.
• Building Relationships: Develop strong, trust-based relationships with clients and team members to drive value and impact.

• Background in finance or accounting, holding a bachelor’s degree or a partial/full accounting qualification (ACA, ACCA, CPA, etc.).

• Knowledgeable in core business processes, ICOFR controls, risk management concepts, and relevant IT tools. Skilled in risk assessment and controls, including scoping, reviewing, testing, deficiency evaluation, optimization, design, implementation, and remediation.
• Strong analytical skills, accuracy and problem-solving abilities.
• Excellent interpersonal, written and verbal communication skills in French and English (German is a plus).
