Location: Zurich Work Pattern Percentage : 60% - 100% Shape how Tax & Legal professionals use AI in their everyday work. As AI becomes an essential part of professional services, our Tax & Legal teams have an exciting opportunity to enhance the way we work, collaborate and deliver value to clients. In this role, you will help translate this opportunity into practical adoption by making AI tools accessible, relevant and easy to use for our people. Working closely with Tax & Legal teams, AI specialists and colleagues across geographies and service lines, you will drive the AI adoption plan, build a strong community of champions and help teams turn ideas into concrete use cases, prompts, templates and automations. How you can make an impact
• Get a detailed understanding of and work with the AI assets our firm has available, and which are used in Tax & Legal, globally, regionally and locally in Switzerland, and get a detailed understanding of the use(d) cases available.
• Be responsible for the increase of the adoption and effective use of AI tools across Tax & Legal by shaping and driving a clear, practical adoption plan
• Design and deliver engaging learning formats, including general and team-specific trainings, self-paced materials, drop-in sessions, and 1-on-1 support
• Identify, test and communicate relevant AI use cases, prompts, templates and automations that help teams work more effectively and create value for clients
• Build and nurture a Tax & Legal AI Community, enabling champions to share experiences, spread knowledge and connect teams across Switzerland and other geographies
• Measure usage and adoption, gather feedback and proactively define actions to improve engagement, confidence and impact over time Who We Are Looking For
• You are curious, well-organised and people-oriented, with a talent for making new technologies understandable, practical and motivating for different audiences
• You have a university degree or equivalent qualification in business, law, tax, technology, innovation management, change management or a related field
• You bring experience in project coordination, change management, learning enablement, digital transformation or technology adoption, ideally in a professional services environment
• You are comfortable experimenting with AI tools and enjoy translating use cases into clear guidance, prompts, templates or simple automations together with specialists
• You communicate confidently in English; German or French is an advantage for collaboration with teams across Switzerland Your Team You will join a collaborative Tax & Legal environment in Switzerland where innovation, knowledge sharing and practical client impact go hand in hand. The role connects closely with professionals across our teams, AI experts in other service lines and geographies, and a growing network of AI champions. Together, you will create an open community where ideas, use cases and experiences are shared, questions are welcomed, and teams are supported in applying AI confidently in their day-to-day work. As AI becomes an essential part of professional services, our Tax & Legal teams have an exciting opportunity to enhance the way we work, collaborate and deliver value to clients. In this role, you will help translate this opportunity into practical adoption by making AI tools accessible, relevant and easy to use for our people. Working closely with Tax & Legal teams, AI specialists and colleagues across geographies and service lines, you will drive the AI adoption plan, build a strong community of champions and help teams turn ideas into concrete use cases, prompts, templates and automations. How you can make an impact
• Get a detailed understanding of and work with the AI assets our firm has available, and which are used in Tax & Legal, globally, regionally and locally in Switzerland, and get a detailed understanding of the use(d) cases available.
• Be responsible for the increase of the adoption and effective use of AI tools across Tax & Legal by shaping and driving a clear, practical adoption plan
• Design and deliver engaging learning formats, including general and team-specific trainings, self-paced materials, drop-in sessions, and 1-on-1 support
• Identify, test and communicate relevant AI use cases, prompts, templates and automations that help teams work more effectively and create value for clients
• Build and nurture a Tax & Legal AI Community, enabling champions to share experiences, spread knowledge and connect teams across Switzerland and other geographies
• Measure usage and adoption, gather feedback and proactively define actions to improve engagement, confidence and impact over time Who We Are Looking For
• You are curious, well-organised and people-oriented, with a talent for making new technologies understandable, practical and motivating for different audiences
• You have a university degree or equivalent qualification in business, law, tax, technology, innovation management, change management or a related field
• You bring experience in project coordination, change management, learning enablement, digital transformation or technology adoption, ideally in a professional services environment
• You are comfortable experimenting with AI tools and enjoy translating use cases into clear guidance, prompts, templates or simple automations together with specialists
• You communicate confidently in English; German or French is an advantage for collaboration with teams across Switzerland Your Team You will join a collaborative Tax & Legal environment in Switzerland where innovation, knowledge sharing and practical client impact go hand in hand. The role connects closely with professionals across our teams, AI experts in other service lines and geographies, and a growing network of AI champions. Together, you will create an open community where ideas, use cases and experiences are shared, questions are welcomed, and teams are supported in applying AI confidently in their day-to-day work. Careers at Deloitte. Choose your impact. At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact. In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors. We offer meaningful and challenging work, an inclusive and supportive environment where you can be your best self and where you will never stop growing. You will benefit from flexible and hybrid working conditions, wellbeing and parental programmes as well as many opportunities to connect, collaborate and learn. Join us and become part of a global network of like-minded people dedicated to making a difference, whether by addressing climate change or improving 100 million futures by 2030. Want to know more about opportunities at Deloitte? Visit www.deloitte.com/ch/careers . How to apply We look forward to hearing from you! Please click on “apply now” to submit a complete application, including CV, cover letter, references and degree certificates. Lieu: Zurich Profil de travail Pourcentage: 60% - 100% Former comment les professionnels de la fiscalité et du droit utilisent l'IA dans leur travail quotidien. À mesure que l'IA devient un élément essentiel des services professionnels, nos équipes Fiscalité et juridique ont l'occasion d'améliorer notre façon de travailler, de collaborer et de fournir de la valeur aux clients. Dans ce rôle, vous aiderez à traduire cette opportunité en adoption pratique en rendant les outils d'IA accessibles, pertinents et faciles à utiliser pour nos gens. En travaillant en étroite collaboration avec les équipes fiscales et juridiques, les spécialistes de l'IA et leurs collègues à travers les géographies et les lignes de service, vous dirigerez le plan d'adoption de l'IA, bâtirez une solide communauté de champions et aiderez les équipes à transformer les idées en cas d'utilisation concrète, des invitations, des modèles et des automatisations. Comment faire un impact
• Obtenez une compréhension et un travail détaillés avec les actifs AI de notre entreprise disponibles, et qui sont utilisés dans Tax & Legal, mondialement, régionalement et localement en Suisse, et obtenez une compréhension détaillée de l'utilisation(d) cas disponibles.
• Être responsable de l'augmentation de l'adoption et de l'utilisation efficace des outils d'IA dans l'ensemble de la fiscalité et juridique en élaborant et en conduisant un plan d'adoption clair et pratique
• Concevoir et offrir des formats d'apprentissage attrayants, y compris des formations générales et spécifiques à l'équipe, du matériel autorapide, des séances d'accueil et un soutien 1 sur 1
• Identifier, tester et communiquer les cas d'utilisation pertinents de l'IA, les invitations, les modèles et les automatisations qui aident les équipes à travailler plus efficacement et à créer de la valeur pour les clients
• Construire et développer une communauté de l'IA fiscale et juridique, permettant aux champions de partager des expériences, de diffuser des connaissances et de relier des équipes à travers la Suisse et d'autres géographies
• Mesurer l'utilisation et l'adoption, recueillir des commentaires et définir des mesures proactives pour améliorer l'engagement, la confiance et l'impact au fil du temps.
• Vous êtes curieux, bien organisé et orienté vers les gens, avec un talent pour rendre les nouvelles technologies compréhensibles, pratiques et motivantes pour différents publics
• Vous avez un diplôme universitaire ou équivalent en affaires, droit, fiscalité, technologie, gestion de l'innovation, gestion du changement ou un domaine connexe
• Vous apportez de l'expérience dans la coordination de projets, la gestion du changement, l'apprentissage, la transformation numérique ou l'adoption de technologies, idéalement dans un environnement de services professionnels
• Vous êtes à l'aise d'expérimenter avec les outils d'IA et profiter de la traduction des cas d'utilisation en conseils clairs, invites, modèles ou automatismes simples avec des spécialistes
• Vous communiquez avec confiance en anglais; l'allemand ou le français est un avantage pour la collaboration avec des équipes à travers la Suisse Votre équipe Vous rejoindrez un environnement fiscal et juridique collaboratif en Suisse où l'innovation, le partage des connaissances et l'impact pratique des clients vont de pair. Ce rôle est étroitement lié aux professionnels de nos équipes, aux experts en AI dans d'autres lignes de service et géographies, et à un réseau croissant de champions de l'IA. Ensemble, vous créerez une communauté ouverte où les idées, les cas d'utilisation et les expériences sont partagés, les questions sont les bienvenues et les équipes sont soutenues dans l'application de l'IA avec confiance dans leur travail quotidien. Carrières chez Deloitte. Choisissez votre impact. Chez Deloitte, vos idées créent un impact et un changement significatif pour nos clients, nos gens et notre société. Votre expertise, votre expérience et votre perspective uniques nous aident à trouver de nouvelles façons de relever les défis les plus complexes afin que nous puissions améliorer l'avenir de nos travaux. Chez Deloitte, vous pouvez construire une carrière qui vous inspire et vous anime. Chez Deloitte, vous pouvez choisir votre impact. En Suisse, nous fournissons des services spécifiques à l'industrie dans les domaines de l'audit et de l'assurance, de la fiscalité et du droit, de la stratégie, du conseil sur les risques et les transactions et de la technologie et de la transformation. Avec près de 3 000 employés sur six sites, nous servons des entreprises et des organisations de toutes tailles dans tous les secteurs de l'industrie. Nous offrons un travail significatif et stimulant, un environnement inclusif et solidaire où vous pouvez être votre meilleur soi et où vous n'arrêterez jamais de grandir. Vous bénéficierez de conditions de travail flexibles et hybrides, de programmes de bien-être et de programmes parentaux ainsi que de nombreuses possibilités de connexion, de collaboration et d'apprentissage. Rejoignez-nous et devenez membre d'un réseau mondial de personnes partageant les mêmes idées et vouées à faire la différence, que ce soit en s'attaquant au changement climatique ou en améliorant 100 millions d'avenir d'ici 2030. Location : Zurich, Geneva Work Pattern Percentage : 80-100% Help Our Clients Successfully Manage Their Compensation and Payroll In today's complex global landscape, compliance is non-negotiable. Tax authorities worldwide are intensifying their focus on payroll accuracy and regulatory adherence—making expert guidance more critical than ever. This is where you come in. The Global Employer Services (GES) team, part of Deloitte's Tax & Legal practice, partners with multinational companies to navigate global mobility and payroll complexity with confidence. We deliver end-to-end payroll solutions and strategic advice that keeps our clients compliant, efficient, and ahead of the curve. How you can make an impact
• You're a client-first professional who thrives on taking ownership. You're self-motivated, committed to continuous learning, and passionate about developing both yourself and your team. You see payroll not as a compliance checkbox, but as a strategic advantage for our clients.
• As a key member of our Payroll team, you'll:
• Drive growth by expanding our Payroll offering and onboarding high-value clients
• Deliver expert counsel on all payroll-related matters, earning client trust through deep expertise
• Own your engagements with full autonomy and accountability for client success
• Champion innovation alongside a management team actively reshaping how payroll services are delivered
• Build and mentor a high-performing team committed to excellence Who we are looking for
• You possess strong numerical skills and a keen understanding of complex interrelationships, demonstrating conscientiousness as well as a solution-oriented and independent working style.
• You have at least 5 to 10 years of experience in payroll and are highly knowledgeable in payroll, social security, and individual taxation.
• You are technology savvy with excellent proficiency in payroll tools such as Abacus and SAP.
• You have a positive attitude toward technological advancements and want to actively support them.
• You have leadership experience and are eager to leverage your expertise to train the team and help expand our market share.
• You have excellent command of English and are fluent in either French or German; additional language skills are considered a significant advantage. Your Team Become part of a diverse, multinational and highly motivated team of 30+ across our Swiss offices. We will help you grow both personally and professionally: through our trainings, mentoring programmes and on-the-job learning, but also by connecting with your colleagues across all business lines. Why Join Us
• Strategic growth area: Payroll is a key focus for our future expansion—you'll be part of an exciting journey
• Collaborative culture: A team-oriented environment that genuinely invests in your personal and professional development
• Competitive package: Attractive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and a robust training program
• Creative freedom: Work with self-motivated professionals who value innovation and fresh thinking Careers at Deloitte. Choose your impact. At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. • Un posto di lavoro sicuro con zero tolleranza per molestie.
• Ambienti aperti dove le persone sono libere di essere se stesse.
• Una comunità inclusiva che crede nel rispetto e nel merito. Posizione: Zurigo, Geneva Work Pattern Percentuale: 80-100% Aiuta i nostri clienti a gestire con successo la loro compensazione e Payroll Nel complesso paesaggio globale di oggi, la conformità non è negoziabile. Le autorità fiscali in tutto il mondo stanno intensificando la loro attenzione sull'accuratezza del libro paga e sull'aderenza normativa, rendendo la guida esperta più critica che mai. E' qui che entri. Il team Global Employer Services (GES), parte della pratica fiscale e legale di Deloitte, collabora con aziende multinazionali per navigare con fiducia nella mobilità globale e nella complessità dei payroll. Offriamo soluzioni payroll end-to-end e consulenza strategica che mantiene i nostri clienti conformi, efficienti e in anticipo della curva. Come si può fare un impatto
• Sei un primo professionista cliente che prospera a prendere possesso. Sei auto-motivato, impegnato nell'apprendimento continuo, e appassionato di sviluppare sia te stesso che la tua squadra. Vedete payroll non come checkbox di conformità, ma come vantaggio strategico per i nostri clienti.
• Come membro chiave del nostro team di Payroll, tu:
• Aumentare la crescita espandendo la nostra offerta Payroll e bordo di clienti ad alto valore
• Fornire un consulente esperto su tutte le questioni relative al libro paga, guadagnare la fiducia del cliente attraverso una profonda esperienza
• Possiedi i tuoi impegni con piena autonomia e responsabilità per il successo del cliente
• L'innovazione del campione accanto a un team di gestione attivamente rimodellare come vengono consegnati i servizi payroll
• Costruire e mentore un team altamente performante impegnato per l'eccellenza Chi stiamo cercando
• Possiedi forti competenze numeriche e una profonda comprensione di interrelazioni complesse, dimostrando coscienziosità e uno stile di lavoro orientato alla soluzione e indipendente.
• Hai almeno 5-10 anni di esperienza nel libro paga e sono altamente competenti nel libro paga, nella sicurezza sociale e nella tassazione individuale.
• Sei esperto di tecnologia con eccellente competenza in strumenti payroll come Abacus e SAP.
• Hai un atteggiamento positivo verso i progressi tecnologici e vuoi sostenerli attivamente.
• Hai esperienza di leadership e sono desiderosi di sfruttare le tue competenze per formare il team e contribuire ad espandere la nostra quota di mercato.
• Hai un ottimo comando dell'inglese e sei fluente sia in francese che in tedesco; le competenze linguistiche aggiuntive sono considerate un vantaggio significativo. Il vostro team fa parte di un team diversificato, multinazionale e altamente motivato di 30+ nei nostri uffici svizzeri. Vi aiuteremo a crescere sia personalmente che professionalmente: attraverso i nostri corsi di formazione, programmi di mentoring e apprendimento on-the-job, ma anche collegando i vostri colleghi in tutte le linee aziendali. Perché unirsi a noi
• Area di crescita strategica: Payroll è un focus fondamentale per la nostra futura espansione – sarete parte di un viaggio emozionante
• Cultura collaborativa: un ambiente di team-oriented che investe in modo autentico nel vostro sviluppo personale e professionale
• Pacchetto competitivo: Compensazione attraente, vantaggi completi e un programma di formazione robusto
• Libertà creativa: lavorare con professionisti auto-motivati che apprezzano l'innovazione e il pensiero fresco Careers a Deloitte. Scegli il tuo impatto. A Deloitte, le tue idee creano impatto e scatenano cambiamenti significativi per i nostri clienti, persone e società. La vostra esperienza, background e prospettiva unica ci aiuta a trovare nuovi modi nelle sfide più complesse in modo da poter illuminare i futuri di quelli che il nostro lavoro colpisce. A Deloitte, puoi costruire una carriera che ti ispira e ti stimola. A Deloitte puoi scegliere il tuo impatto. In Svizzera, forniamo servizi specifici per il settore nei settori Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. Con quasi 3.000 dipendenti in sei sedi, serviamo aziende e organizzazioni di tutte le dimensioni in tutti i settori del settore. Offriamo lavoro significativo e stimolante, un ambiente inclusivo e di supporto in cui si può essere il vostro migliore sé e dove non smetterete mai di crescere. Potrai beneficiare di condizioni di lavoro flessibili e ibridi, il benessere e i programmi genitoriali, così come molte opportunità di connettersi, collaborare e imparare. Unisciti a noi e entra a far parte di una rete globale di persone affini dedicate a fare la differenza, sia affrontando il cambiamento climatico o migliorando 100 milioni di futures entro il 2030. Vuoi saperne di più sulle opportunità a Deloitte? Visita www.apply.deloitte.ch . Come applicare Non vediamo l'ora di sentire da voi! Si prega di fare clic su “applica ora” per presentare una domanda completa, tra cui CV, lettera di copertura, riferimenti e certificati di laurea. Se avete domande, contattate Lena all'indirizzo talent@deloitte.ch © 2026. Per informazioni, contattare Deloitte AG. Tutti i diritti riservati. Deloitte AG è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità. jobs.description:
Location: Zurich Work Pattern Percentage : 80% - 100% Help our clients successfully manage global challenges Our Tax Team offers integrated tax services that help our clients to successfully manage local and global challenges as well as advise on guiding strategies to simplify tax management and achieve global visibility for making informed strategic decisions. As part of the team you will support our clients from the financial industry in answering complex tax law questions and will assist mainly institutions in the banking, insurance and fund industry with strategic and operational tax challenges. How you can make an impact
• Advise domestic and foreign financial institutions on international restructurings, the tax treatment of financial products and answer questions regarding their tax reporting obligations
• Deal with operational tax issues such as withholding tax, stamp duties as well as domestic and foreign withholding taxes
• Conduct tax compliance mandates for banks, insurance companies and fund management companies as well as s upport in audit projects by checking tax aspects in the annual financial statements of banks, insurance companies and fund management companies
• Work on international projects where you have client responsibility, offering the opportunity to work creatively and motivated
• Take responsibility for your own career and explore our exciting career opportunities as well as a broad internal and external training programme as well as train our younger employees and contribute to their development Who We Are Looking For
• You hold a degree as a certified tax expert or a specialised Swiss Master's degree (e.g. LL.M. Swiss and International Taxation)
• You have an academic qualification in administration, economics or law and 6 years of experience in the financial services industry and/or tax/legal consulting with a focus on financial services
• A positive and hands-on attitude as well as the willingness to take over responsibility
• You are curious and like to use your technical and investigative skills
• You communicate fluently in German and English. Any additional languages would be an advantage. Your team Become part of a diverse, multinational and highly motivated team. jobs.description:
Location: Basel, Zurich, Geneva Work Pattern Percentage: 80% - 100% "Make an Impact that Matters" – join us and advise employers and their internationally mobile employees on Swiss and international tax matters. Deploy your curiosity, learn, and continue growing into the trusted advisor for our clients. The world has changed – and so have the many rules that employers must consider. Our clients need fast, technically sound, and practical advice so they can move forward with their projects. We are involved right from the start and have the chance to support as well with the implementation of solutions, providing end-to-end multidisciplinary support. You work in international teams with clients from all over the world. We are solution-oriented and offer a flexible working environment that allows hybrid work. Fill your backpack with practical experience and knowledge from all over the world and develop your tax advisory skills every day with us. How you can make an impact
• You will join our dynamic tax advisory team and will deal with tax advisory projects in a wide range of areas: Swiss and international taxation of cross-border employment structures and planning, equity incentives, pensions, rulings, etc.
• You will have the opportunity to take ownership from day one, to be involved in client-facing activities in projects in the field of individual taxes.
• You can participate and help shape solutions: we advise our clients ad hoc because the general information and easy solutions are already available on the Internet. For this, you do research, write and prepare tailored advice.
• You can learn and apply your technical knowledge directly on interesting cases. You help prepare and deliver presentations to clients and colleagues.
• Combine your strengths and skills with the know-how of our experienced teams – in this power combination you can develop your full professional and personal potential and help our clients in a wide range of individual tax topics. Who We Are Looking For
• You hold a bachelor's or master's degree from a university or university of applied sciences in business administration, law or a similar field.
• You are a team player who appreciates the daily contact with clients and colleagues in our network. You like to work independently, efficiently and question the "status quo".
• You enjoy writing, doing research, exploring options and help design solutions. You are eager to learn and willing to develop and would like to benefit from our tax trainings.
• You are outgoing and enjoy helping people solve their challenges and you also have a thirst for knowledge that will bring new perspective to our projects.
• You speak fluently German or French and have very good English skills. We are looking forward to receiving your application! Your Team Become part of a diverse, dynamic, and highly motivated team that is growing! We value teamwork, exchange of ideas and entrepreneurial thinking. Cohesion, trust and having fun together is part of our everyday cooperation as well as an open feedback culture. With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors. We offer meaningful and challenging work, an inclusive and supportive environment where you can be your best self and where you will never stop growing. Join us and become part of a global network of like-minded people dedicated to making a difference, whether by addressing climate change or improving 100 million futures by 2030. descriptionByLocale.it:
Offriamo con orgoglio:
• Un posto di lavoro sicuro con zero tolleranza per molestie.
• Ambienti aperti dove le persone sono libere di essere se stesse.
• Una comunità inclusiva che crede nel rispetto e nel merito. Location: Basel, Zurich, Geneva Work Pattern Percentage: 80% - 100% "Fare un impatto che Matters" – unisciti a noi e consiglia i datori di lavoro e i loro dipendenti mobili a livello internazionale su questioni fiscali svizzere e internazionali. Sfrutta la tua curiosità, impara e continua a crescere nel consulente di fiducia per i nostri clienti. Il mondo è cambiato – e così hanno le molte regole che i datori di lavoro devono considerare. I nostri clienti hanno bisogno di consigli rapidi, tecnici e pratici, in modo da poter andare avanti con i loro progetti. Siamo coinvolti fin dall'inizio e abbiamo la possibilità di supportare e implementare soluzioni, fornendo supporto multidisciplinare end-to-end. Lavori in team internazionali con clienti di tutto il mondo. Siamo orientati alla soluzione e offriamo un ambiente di lavoro flessibile che consente il lavoro ibrido. Riempi il tuo zaino con esperienza pratica e conoscenza da tutto il mondo e sviluppa le tue capacità di consulenza fiscale ogni giorno con noi. Come si può fare un impatto
• Ti unirai al nostro team di consulenza fiscale dinamico e affronterai progetti di consulenza fiscale in una vasta gamma di settori: tassazione svizzera e internazionale delle strutture di occupazione transfrontaliere e pianificazione, incentivi azionari, pensioni, decisioni, ecc.
• Avrete l'opportunità di prendere possesso dal primo giorno, di essere coinvolti in attività di customer-facing in progetti nel campo delle singole tasse.
• È possibile partecipare e aiutare a modellare le soluzioni: consigliamo ai nostri clienti ad hoc perché le informazioni generali e le soluzioni facili sono già disponibili su Internet. Per questo, fai ricerca, scrivi e preparati consigli su misura.
• Puoi imparare e applicare le tue conoscenze tecniche direttamente su casi interessanti. Aiuta a preparare e consegnare presentazioni a clienti e colleghi.
• Combina i tuoi punti di forza e le tue competenze con il know-how dei nostri team esperti – in questa combinazione di potenza puoi sviluppare il tuo pieno potenziale professionale e personale e aiutare i nostri clienti in una vasta gamma di argomenti fiscali individuali. Chi stiamo cercando
• Lei ha un diploma di laurea o di master da un'università o un'università di scienze applicate in amministrazione aziendale, legge o un campo simile.
• Sei un giocatore di squadra che apprezza il contatto quotidiano con clienti e colleghi nella nostra rete. Ti piace lavorare in modo indipendente, efficiente e mettere in discussione il "status quo".
• Ti piace scrivere, fare ricerca, esplorare le opzioni e aiutare le soluzioni di progettazione. Siete desiderosi di imparare e disposti a svilupparsi e vorrei beneficiare delle nostre formazioni fiscali.
• Stai uscendo e ti piace aiutare le persone a risolvere le loro sfide e hai anche una sete di conoscenza che porterà nuove prospettive ai nostri progetti.
• Si parla fluentemente tedesco o francese e hanno ottime abilità inglesi. Siamo lieti di ricevere la vostra applicazione! Il vostro Team Diventa parte di un team diversificato, dinamico e altamente motivato che sta crescendo! Apprezziamo il lavoro di squadra, lo scambio di idee e il pensiero imprenditoriale. La coesione, la fiducia e il divertimento insieme fanno parte della nostra collaborazione quotidiana e di una cultura del feedback aperta. Il team ha sede in tutti gli uffici della Svizzera mentre lavoriamo a stretto contatto con i nostri colleghi di altre squadre e serviamo i nostri clienti in tutte le industrie. Carriere a Deloitte. Scegli il tuo impatto. A Deloitte, le tue idee creano impatto e scatenano cambiamenti significativi per i nostri clienti, persone e società. La vostra esperienza, background e prospettiva unica ci aiuta a trovare nuovi modi nelle sfide più complesse in modo da poter illuminare i futuri di quelli che il nostro lavoro colpisce. A Deloitte, puoi costruire una carriera che ti ispira e ti stimola. A Deloitte puoi scegliere il tuo impatto. In Svizzera, forniamo servizi specifici per il settore nei settori Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. Con quasi 3.000 dipendenti in sei sedi, serviamo aziende e organizzazioni di tutte le dimensioni in tutti i settori del settore. Offriamo lavoro significativo e stimolante, un ambiente inclusivo e di supporto in cui si può essere il vostro migliore sé e dove non smetterete mai di crescere. Potrai beneficiare di condizioni di lavoro flessibili e ibridi, il benessere e i programmi genitoriali, così come molte opportunità di connettersi, collaborare e imparare. Unisciti a noi e entra a far parte di una rete globale di persone affini dedicate a fare la differenza, sia affrontando il cambiamento climatico o migliorando 100 milioni di futures entro il 2030. Vuoi saperne di più sulle opportunità a Deloitte? Visitate www.deloitte.com/ch/careers . Come applicare Non vediamo l'ora di sentire da voi! Si prega di fare clic su “applica ora” per presentare una domanda completa, tra cui CV, lettera di copertura, riferimenti e certificati di laurea. Se hai domande, contatta Lena all'indirizzo talent@deloitte.ch * Consideriamo tutti i candidati qualificati per l'occupazione indipendentemente da razza, etnia, credenze religiose, sesso, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, origine nazionale, età o disabilità, in conformità con la legge applicabile. La ricerca mostra che le donne sono meno propensi a candidarsi per i ruoli a meno che non corrispondano a tutti i criteri; non trattenetevi indietro – applicare oggi. Non accettiamo richieste da agenzie di reclutamento per questa posizione. © 2026. Per informazioni, contattare Deloitte AG. Tutti i diritti riservati. Deloitte AG è un datore di lavoro pari opportunità.

Nos clients ont besoin de conseils rapides, techniquement solides et pratiques pour aller de l'avant avec leurs projets. Nous sommes impliqués dès le départ et avons la chance de soutenir aussi bien la mise en œuvre de solutions, en fournissant un soutien multidisciplinaire de bout en bout. Vous travaillez en équipe internationale avec des clients du monde entier. Nous sommes orientés vers la solution et offrons un environnement de travail flexible qui permet le travail hybride. Remplissez votre sac à dos avec l'expérience pratique et les connaissances du monde entier et développez vos compétences de conseil fiscal chaque jour avec nous. Comment faire un impact
• Vous rejoindrez notre équipe de conseil fiscal dynamique et traiterez de projets de conseil fiscal dans un large éventail de domaines : fiscalité suisse et internationale des structures et de la planification transfrontalières de l'emploi, incitations à l'équité, pensions, décisions, etc.
• Vous aurez l'occasion de prendre possession dès le premier jour, de participer à des activités axées sur la clientèle dans le cadre de projets dans le domaine des impôts individuels.
• Vous pouvez participer et aider à concevoir des solutions: nous conseillons nos clients ad hoc car les informations générales et les solutions faciles sont déjà disponibles sur Internet. Pour cela, vous faites des recherches, écrivez et préparez des conseils personnalisés.
• Vous pouvez apprendre et appliquer vos connaissances techniques directement sur des cas intéressants. Vous aidez à préparer et à présenter des présentations aux clients et aux collègues.

jobs.description:
Location: Zurich Work Pattern Percentage: 80-100% Advise international clients on cutting-edge technology for their business As (Senior) Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will be the newest member among our Technology Strategy & Transformation specialists and help organizations to develop strategies and implement systems that build business value and drive performance. We combine in-depth knowledge and experience gained from working on some of the most complex IT projects around the globe, from system replacement to full IT transformation. By enriching us, you will gain valuable insights into IT strategy and operating model design, IT architecture, IT business management, IT agility advisory, and IT M&A – we’re looking forward to having you with us! How you can make an impact:
• Collaborate with our customer – with support from your experienced colleagues – on challenging problems and solutions to translate their strategies into effective enterprise architecture
• Support the enterprise, business, and solution architects of our clients to define solution architecture for large programmes
• Govern the implementation of our solutions while you support in the coordination of multi-disciplinary delivery teams
• Conduct analysis, take part in workshops and status meetings, and prepare architecture documents and presentations
• Be the key enabler and build the bridge between business and IT to make a real impact for our clients Who we are looking for:
• Besides being a reliable character, you enjoy working methodically, have a great attention to detail and a thirst for knowledge, bring in fresh perspectives to a fast-paced environment, and excel at following through and getting things done
• After graduating in applied mathematics, computer science or a comparable degree, you gained first professional experience developing software, solution, and enterprise architecture, and ideally have a clear understanding of the software development lifecycle
• Experience with managing business and IT stakeholders, coordinating multi-disciplinary teams, certifications in TOGAF, IT project management or Open Group Certified Architect are an advantage
• You communicate fluently in both English and German and look forward to travelling (mainly within Switzerland); additional French skills are an advantage Your team By joining the team in our Zurich office, you will be integrated into a diverse group of like-minded colleagues right from the first day. As we take your professional development seriously, we offer you full access to our comprehensive internal and external training programme. As part of the Technology Strategy & Transformation team you will work directly with our clients to define and execute IT Architecture and shape the way IT interacts with the business. Becoming part of our team means benefiting from our expertise, our deep understanding of technology as well as from our excellent communication skills and in-depth business understanding. Look forward to working together with some of the largest organisations in Switzerland and across the world to introduce the change that will create real impact for their business. How to apply We look forward to hearing from you! Please click on "apply now" to submit a complete application, including CV, cover letter, references and degree certificates. If you have any questions, please contact Jennifer at talent@deloitte.ch Life at Deloitte At Deloitte, your ideas create impact and spark meaningful change for our clients, people and society. Your unique expertise, background and perspective helps us find new ways into the most complex challenges so we can brighten the futures of those our work affects. At Deloitte, you can build a career that inspires and energises you. At Deloitte, you can choose your impact. In Switzerland, we provide industry-specific services in the areas of Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors. We offer meaningful and challenging work, an inclusive and supportive environment where you can be your best self and where you will never stop growing. You will benefit from flexible and hybrid working conditions, wellbeing and parental programmes as well as many opportunities to connect, collaborate and learn. Join us and become part of a global network of like-minded people dedicated to making a difference, whether by addressing climate change or improving 100 million futures by 2030. Want to know more about opportunities at Deloitte? Visit www.deloitte.com/ch/careers . How to apply We look forward to hearing from you! Please click on "apply now" to submit a complete application, including CV, cover letter, references and degree certificates. If you have any questions, please contact Jennifer at talent@deloitte.ch We consider all qualified applicants for employment regardless of race, ethnicity, religious beliefs, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age or disability, in accordance with applicable law. Research shows that women are less likely to apply for roles unless they match all the criteria; don’t hold yourself back - apply today. We do not accept applications from recruitment agencies for this position. Deloitte AG and Deloitte Consulting AG are Swiss subsidiaries of Deloitte LLP, the DTTL member firm in the United Kingdom. • Un posto di lavoro sicuro con zero tolleranza per molestie.
• Ambienti aperti dove le persone sono libere di essere se stesse.

• Oltre ad essere un personaggio affidabile, ti piace lavorare metodicamente, avere una grande attenzione ai dettagli e una sete di conoscenza, portare in prospettive fresche in un ambiente frenetico, e eccellere a seguire e ottenere le cose fatte

• Esperienza con la gestione degli stakeholder aziendali e IT, il coordinamento di team multidisciplinari, certificazioni in TOGAF, IT project management o Open Group Certified Architect sono un vantaggio
• Si comunica fluentemente sia in inglese che in tedesco e non vede l'ora di viaggiare (principalmente all'interno della Svizzera); ulteriori competenze francesi sono un vantaggio Il vostro team Unendo il team nel nostro ufficio di Zurigo, sarete integrati in un gruppo diverso di colleghi simili sin dal primo giorno. Prendendo sul serio il vostro sviluppo professionale, vi offriamo l'accesso completo al nostro programma di formazione interno ed esterno completo. Nell'ambito del team Technology Strategy & Transformation lavorerai direttamente con i nostri clienti per definire ed eseguire l'architettura IT e modellare il modo in cui l'IT interagisce con l'azienda. Diventare parte del nostro team significa trarre beneficio dalla nostra esperienza, dalla nostra profonda comprensione della tecnologia e dalle nostre eccellenti capacità di comunicazione e dalla comprensione aziendale approfondita. Non vediamo l'ora di lavorare insieme ad alcune delle più grandi organizzazioni in Svizzera e in tutto il mondo per introdurre il cambiamento che creerà un impatto reale per la loro attività. Non vediamo l'ora di sentire da voi! Clicca su "apply now" per presentare una domanda completa, tra cui CV, lettera di copertura, riferimenti e certificati di laurea. Se avete domande, si prega di contattare Jennifer a talent@deloitte.ch Life a Deloitte A Deloitte, le vostre idee creano impatto e scintilla cambiamento significativo per i nostri clienti, persone e società. La vostra esperienza, background e prospettiva unica ci aiuta a trovare nuovi modi nelle sfide più complesse in modo da poter illuminare i futuri di quelli che il nostro lavoro colpisce. A Deloitte, puoi costruire una carriera che ti ispira e ti stimola. A Deloitte, puoi scegliere il tuo impatto. In Svizzera, forniamo servizi specifici per il settore nei settori Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. Con quasi 3.000 dipendenti in sei sedi, serviamo aziende e organizzazioni di tutte le dimensioni in tutti i settori industriali. Offriamo lavoro significativo e stimolante, un ambiente inclusivo e di supporto in cui si può essere il vostro migliore sé e dove non smetterete mai di crescere. Potrai beneficiare di condizioni di lavoro flessibili e ibridi, il benessere e i programmi genitoriali, così come molte opportunità per collegare, collaborare e imparare. Unisciti a noi e entra a far parte di una rete globale di persone affini dedicate a fare la differenza, sia affrontando il cambiamento climatico o migliorando 100 milioni di futures entro il 2030. Vuoi saperne di più sulle opportunità a Deloitte? Visitate www.deloitte.com/ch/careers . Non vediamo l'ora di sentire da voi! Clicca su "apply now" per presentare una domanda completa, tra cui CV, lettera di copertura, riferimenti e certificati di laurea. Se hai domande, contatta Jennifer all'indirizzo talent@deloitte.ch Consideriamo tutti i candidati qualificati per l'occupazione indipendentemente da razza, etnia, credenze religiose, sesso, orientamento sessuale, identità di genere, origine nazionale, età o disabilità, in conformità con la legge applicabile. La ricerca mostra che le donne sono meno propensi a candidarsi per i ruoli a meno che non corrispondano a tutti i criteri; non trattenetevi indietro - si applicano oggi. Non accettiamo domande da agenzie di reclutamento per questa posizione. Deloitte AG e Deloitte Consulting AG sono filiali svizzere di Deloitte LLP, società membro della DTTL nel Regno Unito. jobs.description:
Location: Basel, Zurich, Geneva Work Pattern Percentage: 80% - 100% Help our clients successfully manage global challenges As a (Assistant) Manager in the Global Employer Services (GES) team, you will provide multi-national companies with targeted advice and strategies for running Global Mobility programs in an efficient manner. Our team supports clients with the end-to-end management of global compensation for internationally mobile employees and optimization of Tax compliance and positions. As part of the US Tax team, you will advise on US tax returns and compliance topics and do the final signoff of US tax returns before delivery. How you can make an impact
• Coordinate our global tax compliance services including liaising directly with clients and Deloitte offices worldwide.
• Review and sign US individual income tax returns for US resident and nonresident taxpayers, including Forms 1040, 114, 8938, 1116, 2555, 8858, and other forms specific to US residents with activities outside the United States.
• Review and sign tax reconciliations and tax equalization calculations and lead various other tasks related to the successful delivery of Global Mobility programs for our clients.
• Oversee the completion of tasks and quality of the work done by junior members of the team.
• Interpret and implement International Assignment Policies and ensure consistent global tax treatment of various assignment compensation items and allowances.
• Advise our clients on the tax and social security implications related to various global employment issues including tax residency, avoidance of double taxation and the taxation of complex compensation such as severance payments, long term and short-term incentive income. Who We Are Looking For
• You have successfully completed your Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Economics, Accountancy, or Law.
• You have 5 years+ US tax experience/knowledge and hold relevant qualification (e.g. EA, CPA, etc).
• Experience in global mobility or a “Big-4” firm is a plus.
• You are curious to find answers, take the initiative and are happy taking on responsibility and like to work in project teams with a systematic approach.
• You communicate fluently in English. Any further languages would be an advantage. Your Team Become part of a diverse, multinational and highly motivated team of 8 across our Geneva and Zurich offices. We will help you grow both personally and professionally: through our trainings, mentoring programmes, and on-the-job learning, but also by connecting with your colleagues across all business lines. With close to 3,000 employees at six locations, we serve companies and organisations of all sizes in all industry sectors. • Si comunica fluentemente in inglese. Qualsiasi altra lingua sarebbe un vantaggio. Il vostro team fa parte di un team multinazionale e altamente motivato di 8 persone nei nostri uffici di Ginevra e Zurigo. Vi aiuteremo a crescere sia personalmente che professionalmente: attraverso le nostre formazioni, programmi di mentoring, e l'apprendimento on-the-job, ma anche collegando i vostri colleghi in tutte le linee di business. La vostra esperienza, background e prospettiva unica ci aiuta a trovare nuovi modi nelle sfide più complesse in modo da poter illuminare i futuri di quelli che il nostro lavoro colpisce. A Deloitte, puoi costruire una carriera che ti ispira e ti stimola. A Deloitte, puoi scegliere il tuo impatto. In Svizzera, forniamo servizi specifici per il settore nei settori Audit & Assurance, Tax & Legal, Strategy, Risk & Transactions Advisory, and Technology & Transformation. Con quasi 3.000 dipendenti in sei sedi, serviamo aziende e organizzazioni di tutte le dimensioni in tutti i settori industriali. Offriamo lavoro significativo e stimolante, un ambiente inclusivo e di supporto in cui si può essere il vostro migliore sé e dove non smetterete mai di crescere. Potrai beneficiare di condizioni di lavoro flessibili e ibridi, il benessere e i programmi genitoriali, così come molte opportunità per collegare, collaborare e imparare. Unisciti a noi e entra a far parte di una rete globale di persone affini dedicate a fare la differenza, sia affrontando il cambiamento climatico o migliorando 100 milioni di futures entro il 2030.
